L26n1564.name: Digits inside numbers
L26n1564.description: Digit tokens inside multi-digit numbers and years (the 0 in 14,000, the 2 in 2,000, the 0 in 0 AD), strongest on the 2nd and later digits. Pushes the model toward more digit tokens. Pushed hard, it outputs garbled word fragments, not digits.

L26n1059.name: Split-word first fragment
L26n1059.description: The first fragment of a word or name split into several tokens, such as 'Pr' in Prisc-ius, 'Ram' in Ramkham, 'Prom' in Prompts, 'alm' in Talmud. Fires before the word is complete. Pushes toward code-style '(_' and '{_' tokens.

L26n1379.name: Taxon name middles
L26n1379.description: The middle fragment of a split proper or taxonomic name, mostly 'ter' in Pteridaceae and Pteridophyta, 'uth' in Buthidae, and 'en' in Cenozoic. Also fires on 'San' and 'Sam' starting place names. Pushes toward '+'-prefixed tokens.

L26n2172.name: sp- word onsets
L26n2172.description: The opening 'sp' or 'spr' fragment of a word split into tokens, such as Sp in Spence and Sparta, and spr in sprouts and sprang. Pushes toward 'template' tokens.

L26n1014.name: sl/wh word onsets
L26n1014.description: The opening fragment of a split word, mostly 'sl' (slant, slides, slotted), 'wh' (whiff, whizz, whistling), and 'ot' (otoscope). Pushes toward 'Java' and 'java' tokens.

L26n2109.name: br/tort word fragments
L26n2109.description: Short opening or middle fragments of split words: 'br' in bruxism, 'cort' in corticotropin, 'Vit' in vitiligo, 'tort' in tortillas, 'Att' in Attalea. Pushes toward 'html' tokens.

L26n2128.name: Period in numbers
L26n2128.description: The decimal point or sentence-final period right after a number or clause (14.5 oz, 41.5 per, 'Thursday.'). Pushes toward ellipsis and bracket tokens such as '[…]' and ');'.

L26n589.name: cr/cor word onsets
L26n589.description: The 'cr', 'cor', or 'co' opening fragment of a word split into tokens, such as Crème, crabs, crumbled, coracoid, coriander. Pushes toward quote-and-comma separator tokens.

L26n1697.name: Vehicle and transport nouns
L26n1697.description: Transport and space nouns such as boat, car, ferry, truck, bike, plane, and 'space' (boat-building, car ferry, space telescope). Pushes toward 'ticket(s)' and 'guest' tokens.

L26n2794.name: Word onsets, submit
L26n2794.description: The opening fragment of split words and names: Pan in Panzer, Bro in Broccoli, Bre in Breasted, Syn in Synod, stro in stroopkoek. Pushes toward 'submit' and 'submission' tokens.

L26n2357.name: Tech brand names
L26n2357.description: Brand or product names in tech and consumer goods, such as Google, Adobe, Android, BlackBerry, Chrome, and iPod, on the name token. Pushes toward 'camera' tokens.

L26n1991.name: in-/re- word onsets
L26n1991.description: The opening 'ins', 'inc', 'inn', 'res', or 'resc' fragment of words with in- or re- prefixes (inscriptions, incidence, rescinded). Pushes toward 'ind' and 'Ind' tokens.

L26n747.name: Long-name middle fragments
L26n747.description: The middle piece of a long split name: 'ace' in Ophioglossaceae, 'bip' in biphenyl, 'dich' in dichromate, 'Grü' in Grünewald. Pushes toward dash and dot filler tokens and whitespace.

L26n1977.name: B/b word onsets
L26n1977.description: A capital or lowercase 'B' or 'b' opening a split word or name (Babylon, Babbage, B2B, Bahá), plus 'Cong' and 'Cal'. Pushes toward 'conversion' and 'convert' tokens.

L26n2451.name: pro/app/apr word onsets
L26n2451.description: The opening fragment of words starting pro-, app-, or apr- (APPRO, appalled, apricots, proportional, propellant). Pushes toward 'prop' and 'Prop' tokens.

L26n1087.name: Ram/Est name onsets
L26n1087.description: The opening fragment of a split name, mostly 'Ram' (Ramayana, Ramkham, Ramnians), plus 'Est', 'Pret', 'Lib', and 'Cham'. Pushes toward C++ tokens such as '.cpp' and 'cout'.

L26n0.name: Diffuse word completions
L26n0.description: Heterogeneous: the word-completing token of a phrase in mixed text (high-end, pessimistic assumptions, April, Python, injuries). No single pattern. Pushes toward quote-and-punctuation tokens.

L25n2952.name: Mid-word compound fragments
L25n2952.description: Fragments inside compound or long words: dif- in diffracting, sub- in sub-processor, Dub- in Dubbert, roph- in claustrophobia, iph- in biphobia. Pushes toward 'frequency' tokens.

L26n1002.name: nond/und/d word fragments
L26n1002.description: Short opening or inner fragments such as 'nond' (nondiscriminatory), 'und' (undies), 'd' (Datasheet, dwellings), and '-d' (anti-drying). Pushes toward 'crypt' and 'encrypt' tokens.

L26n2677.name: oc/c word onsets
L26n2677.description: The opening 'oc', 'c', 'suc', 'Prec', or 'Rec' fragment of a split word (occur, occlusal, cations, sucralose, Precision). Pushes toward 'kernel' and 'shell' tokens.

L25n1531.name: Split-word 'v' fragments
L25n1531.description: Mid-word fragment inside a split name or word, especially 'v' or '-v' (Nau|v|oo, un|v|accinated, low|-v|oltage, '-z' in zippers); pushes toward 'criteria' and 'threshold'.

L26n2852.name: Word fragment → trigger
L26n2852.description: First or middle piece of a rare word split into several tokens (confl|uent, atro|ops, Fl|ouroquinolones, Eph|ial|tes); pushes toward 'trigger'.

L26n497.name: Foreign name fragments, download
L26n497.description: Middle piece of a foreign or unusual proper name split across tokens (Fab|erg|é, Yog|ī, Kuh|aj|da, Alm|oh|ad); pushes toward 'download' and 'upload'.

L25n1786.name: Modal before action verb
L25n1786.description: Token just before an action verb, mostly 'can' or 'to' or 'and' in permission phrases (users can| install, allow users to| create, settings and| click), plus mid-word pieces (re|configuring); pushes toward 'enable' and 'enabled'.

L26n2870.name: Word-initial 'em/ex' prefix
L26n2870.description: First piece of words starting with em- or ex- (em|igration, em|pires, em|ir, ex|otic, Ex|clusion); pushes toward 'export' and 'foreign'.

L26n2358.name: Preposition before place names
L26n2358.description: 'in', 'of', 'and', 'at' or 'against' right before a place, city, country or team name (in Dubai, between Johannesburg and Durban, port of Dar); pushes toward province and US-state names like Alabama and Oregon.

L25n567.name: Mid-word 'p' fragments, adjust
L25n567.description: The 'p' or 'P' piece inside a split word (stock|p|iled, un|p|asteurized, NO|P|ASSWD, P|PT) and similar mid-word fragments; pushes toward 'adjust' and 'adjustment'.

L26n2611.name: Split name fragments, roll
L26n2611.description: First piece of a split or capitalised name or word (dre|idel, Fab|erg|é, Mont|ellaro, Fl|ank, Med|upi); pushes toward 'roll' and 'rolling'.

L26n1854.name: Word-start 'mult-' fragment
L26n1854.description: The 'mult' piece opening multi- words (mult|ilocular, mult|icolor, mult|ilined), plus 'min', 'sem' and 'ant' opening split words (min|strel, sem|isolid, ant|ibiotics); pushes toward 'io' and 'ias' tokens.

L26n668.name: Surname fragments, pre-noun words
L26n668.description: Surname or name pieces (Alf|ano, El|f, Sa|uerkraut) and words right before a noun phrase (such as, professor at, a local); pushes toward 'participant' and 'participants'.

L26n2756.name: Medical word fragments, flex
L26n2756.description: Opening piece of medical or anatomical words split into tokens (m|ucus, m|asticatory, sal|iv|ary, eyel|eb|row, str|aits); pushes toward 'flex' and 'flexible'.

L26n1194.name: Company name second word
L26n1194.description: The word right after the first word of a company or organisation name (Warner Bros, Florida Power, Long Island Railroad, Federal Emergency Relief); pushes toward 'Co' and 'CO' company tokens.

L26n2547.name: Media and product labels
L26n2547.description: The word that completes a media or product label (free software, CD maxi-single, Half-Speed, this ebook, View PDF); pushes toward 'CD' and 'cd' tokens.

L26n1458.name: Word-start fragments, mixed topics
L26n1458.description: First piece of a multi-token word, often the start of a noun (fasc|iitis, arr|hythmias, Hug|uenots, puzz|les, UT|I, Scout B|SA); pushes toward 'sports' and 'sport'.

L26n1984.name: Proper name opening piece
L26n1984.description: Opening piece of a proper or place name split into tokens (Poly|technic, Bav|aria, Pot|omac, Hung|a Haʻapai, Battle of Gettysburg); pushes toward 'technique' and 'technical'.

L26n2427.name: Word-start fragments → sales
L26n2427.description: First piece of a split or proper-noun word (Cass|ini, Dec|isions, Sy|camore, Cad|mium, Lind|ner); pushes toward 'sales', 'sell' and 'sold'.

L25n2313.name: Cancel-verb opening pieces, null
L25n2313.description: First piece of verbs meaning cancel or abolish, mostly 'ab-' and 'ann-' (ab|ridged, ab|ating, ann|ulment, ren|ounce); pushes toward 'null' and 'nullify'.

L26n2498.name: Name pieces and 'sc-'
L26n2498.description: Opening piece of split proper names (Bort|nyik, Zat|orre, Rzew|uski, Han|uman) and 'sc' in scoliosis or scarring; pushes toward 'score' and 'scores'.

L26n2130.name: Varied name fragments
L26n2130.description: Scattered first or middle pieces of split names or words (Dor|is, Kwan|zaa, Van Reenen, KwaZulu-N|atal, Ret|inoids), with no single theme; pushes toward 'letter' and 'letters'.

L26n2089.name: Word-initial 'c' fragments
L26n2089.description: The single letter 'c' or 'C' that opens a word split into tokens (c|asserole, c|actus, c|abling, C|ars, C|ited); pushes toward 'profile' and 'profiles'.

L26n1994.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L26n1994.description: Goes negative on a piece in the middle of a name or word split across tokens, e.g. 'Giamp|etro', 'Woll|ongong', 'CAR|olina', 'Hel|ens', 'self-lo|ve'; writes 'loop' tokens, which do not match what it reads.

L26n1591.name: Stem before -age ending
L26n1591.description: Goes negative on the stem just before an '-age', '-aged' or '-ages' ending that is split into its own token, e.g. 'lever|ages', 'gar|ages', 'volt|ages', 'append|ages', 'Enc|our|aging', 'pre-pack|aged'; writes 'ag'/'agent' tokens, the start of that same ending.

L26n1399.name: Mid-word fragments, writes pre
L26n1399.description: Goes positive on a fragment inside a longer word split across tokens, e.g. 'therm|ore|gulation', 'Organochlor|P|esticides', 'R|ip|arian', 'Ap|ol|ip|oprotein', 'gly|cope|ptide', 'Rep|resents'; pushes the model toward 'pre/Pres/preserve' tokens.

L26n2040.name: Word-start capital fragments
L26n2040.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split across tokens, often a short onset such as 'C' in 'Colds' or 'Cite', 'inc' in 'incorporating', 'oc' in 'recur', 'Anch' in 'Anchorage'; writes 'cor/Cor/COR' tokens.

L26n2446.name: Single-letter m onset
L26n2446.description: Goes negative on the single letter 'm' that starts a word split across tokens, e.g. 'm|ucus', 'Al-m|ohad', 'm|asher', 'm|ugs', and 'metam|orphosis'; writes compass words such as 'North', 'South', 'east'.

L25n930.name: St in saint names
L25n930.description: Goes positive on 'St' that opens a saint or place name (St. Mary's, St. Paul's, St. Anthony, St. Andrews), especially after 'at', 'of' or 'dean of'; writes 'np' tokens, which are unrelated to the names.

L26n2125.name: Consonant-cluster word onsets
L26n2125.description: Goes negative on the piece of a split word that opens with a consonant cluster, e.g. 'bl' in 'blurring' and 'Blaeu', 'cr' in 'crumbly', 'crabs' and 'crinolines', 'dil' in 'dilates'; writes 'rec/Rec' tokens.

L25n2197.name: Proper-name first pieces
L25n2197.description: Goes positive on the first or second token of a proper name split across tokens, e.g. 'Ob|ispo', 'Ho|jiblanca', 'Rou|en', 'Koh|li', 'Bo|iry', 'Ras|porich'; writes 'efficiency/efficient' tokens, which are unrelated.

L26n2348.name: Word-start fragments, writes notice
L26n2348.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a word split across tokens, e.g. 'inc|isors', 'inc|ision', 'inc|idence', 'Nec|rolestes', 'ting|ling', 'Cratæ|g|us'; pushes the model toward 'notice/notification/alert' tokens.

L26n1154.name: Mid-word split before ending
L26n1154.description: Goes negative on a fragment that stops mid-word just before its completing piece, e.g. 'extingu|ish', 'skirm|ish', 'stret|cher', 'sebor|r|hea', 'enc|ro|ached', 'explo|red', and on '(' before an acronym such as 'CIHI'; writes 'ah/gh' tokens.

L26n460.name: Term-completing word in lists
L26n460.description: Diffuse and weak: goes negative on the word that completes a term or label in lists, quizzes and tables, e.g. 'Compound [Interest]', 'vitamin B1 [deficiency]', 'Roman Numerals - [I]', 'without [soil]'; writes quote and bracket closers, and steering changes the answers very little.

L26n130.name: Punctuation inside numbers
L26n130.description: Goes negative on a decimal point, comma or hyphen inside a number or a name, e.g. '14[.]5oz', '31[.]7 m', '10[,]575', '2[.]36 in', 'Merriam[-]Webster'; writes ending periods and quote marks, and steering makes the model output a column of periods.

L26n1585.name: Word-start fragments, writes direction
L26n1585.description: Goes positive on word-start fragments of words split across tokens, strongest on 'radi' (radiographs, radiating, radiologists, RADIATION) and also 'stage', 'art' and 'orient'; pushes the model toward 'direction/dir' tokens.

L26n488.name: Letters inside acronyms
L26n488.description: Goes positive on a letter or piece inside an acronym or abbreviation split across tokens, e.g. 'P<<DD>>-NOS', '(<<R>>NG)', '¹<<⁴>>C', '(<<DS>>HS)'; pushes the model to write more acronym letters ('NS', 'NG', 'ns'), and steering produces 'NSNSNS'.

L26n1421.name: Start of split names
L26n1421.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a capitalized name or word split across tokens, especially 'Str' (Stronsay, Strait), 'imp' (impoundment, implicate), 'Dol' (Dolaucothi), 'Ad' (Aden) and 'Gr' (Grisons); writes 'job/jobs' tokens.

L26n2912.name: G onset fragments
L26n2912.description: Goes negative on the 'G' onset piece of a word or name split across tokens, mostly 'gu', 'gr', 'gor', 'Ge', 'Gy' and 'ug', as in 'guising', 'guayule', 'grilling', 'grizzly' and 'Novgorod'; writes 'commit/repo' tokens.

L26n2610.name: Piece after a hyphen
L26n2610.description: Goes positive on the piece right after a hyphen or inside a compound, especially '-b' in 'coal-burning', 'fire-bombing', 'water-borne' and 'non-biodegradable', and also 'Dol|au|cothi'; pushes the model toward 'Mac/mac/Canada' tokens.

L26n1100.name: Prefix fragments ep, comp
L26n1100.description: Goes positive on a prefix or stem fragment that starts a longer word split across tokens, especially 'ep' (epigenetics, epilepsy), 'Comp' (compounds), 'non' (nonproliferation), 'hyper' (hyperbole) and 'post' (post-traumatic); pushes the model toward 'part/partial' tokens.

L26n2715.name: Name/stem start, writes enhance
L26n2715.description: Goes negative on the first or middle piece of a word or name split across tokens, e.g. 'Có' (Córdoba), 'Č' (Tomo Čačić), 'kr' (krill), 'pal' (palmitoleic), 'wal' (walnuts), 'ith' (clarithromycin); writes 'enhance/enhancement' tokens.
L26n2715.name_orig: Name or stem start, writes enhance

L25n1927.name: Sch word-start fragment
L25n1927.description: Goes negative on the 'Sch' or 'ch' onset piece of a word or name split across tokens, e.g. 'Sch' in Schuller, Schwerin, Scholars and Schenck|ensch|ans, and 'proph' in prophylaxis; writes 'protect/protection' tokens.

L26n1728.name: Split word starts
L26n1728.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or word split across tokens, before its completing piece (e.g. 'Me' in Mind-Me-ister, 'Man' in Manitoba, 'ib' in Leibniz, 'fl' in flares); pushes toward 'friend' and steers into 'Friend friends' spam.

L26n455.name: Negating un- prefix
L26n455.description: Fires on the 'un' prefix token that opens a split word (unimportant, unqualified, unvaccinated, unclaimed, unaltered), plus some hyphen and capital-N word starts; pushes toward 'c'/'ci' tokens, so steered output degrades into 'c' spam.

L25n2262.name: Split name fragments
L25n2262.description: Fires on a token inside a split proper noun or technical word that carries its identity (ob in Chernobyl, Beth in Bethany, Dev in Deviations, X in Xerxes, B in Babylon); pushes toward 'shift' tokens and steers into 'Shift shift' spam.

L26n2374.name: Name and compound middles
L26n2374.description: Fires on a stem or middle piece of a split place name or compound term (Kos in Kosrae, Co in Cordoba, sap in sapodilla, crop in crop rotations, split in split capacitor); pushes toward 'ring' and 'circular' words and steers into 'Ring ring' spam.

L26n153.name: Word starts, quote output
L26n153.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a split word or proper name (Le in Leashes, Batter in Batteries, Kings in Kings Cross, ens in Queensland) and on 'degrees' after a temperature; pushes toward quotation marks and brackets, with steered drift into random nouns.

L26n1562.name: Word-start par, b
L26n1562.description: Fires on the opening piece of a word split over tokens, especially 'par' (Parmesan, parrots, Parthenon), 'b' (breading, bumbling, biodegradable) and 'po' (poachers); pushes toward number words and steers into 'Five five five' spam.

L26n268.name: Acronym letters after parenthesis
L26n268.description: Fires on the first letters of an acronym, mostly right after an opening parenthesis (ATL, AIDS, UAB, APHA, LEAs, IELA, MDA); pushes toward capital 'AI' and 'AV' tokens and steers into 'AI AI AI' spam.

L26n1263.name: Word starts, ordinals
L26n1263.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split over tokens, mostly 'sm', 'sp', 'K' and 'I' (smooching, spayed, spires, Kassites, Iraq); pushes toward ordinal words and steers into 'Third third' spam.

L25n1027.name: Clause openers after hazards
L25n1027.description: Fires on the word right after a clause-opening word or modal in warning or instruction text (who in 'who reads it', might in 'that might damage', not in 'do not damage', or in 'or panic'); pushes toward 'exit' and 'escape' words.

L26n2779.name: Name middle pieces
L26n2779.description: Fires on a piece of a split proper name or word (Laf in Lafitte, Hon in van Honk, hon in honours, Barg in Barguzin, ago in Zaragoza); pushes toward 'observ-' words and steers into 'Observ observed observation' spam.

L26n1448.name: Name pieces, mo output
L26n1448.description: Fires on a piece of a split proper name or word (jo in Mohenjo-daro, kel in Ashkelon, isk in Oshkosh, Dev in Devonta, accom in accompaniment); pushes toward 'mo' and 'monthly' tokens and steers into 'Mo mo' spam.

L25n2831.name: Sl and Chern starts
L25n2831.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word or name, strongest on 'Sl' (Slavery, Slaves, Slavic) and 'Chern' (Chernobyl), with weaker hits on Tibetan and Latinized; pushes toward royalty words (king, queen, royal) and steers into 'King King' spam.

L26n3013.name: Initial P word starts
L26n3013.description: Fires on a lone capital or lowercase 'P' that opens a word split over tokens (Palla, Potters, Patches, Puffins, Pustules, Pteridomania) and on 'ort' in Bortnyik; pushes toward 'measurement' words and steers into 'Measurement measurement' spam.

L26n2046.name: Word starts ro, Mer
L26n2046.description: Fires on short word-start pieces of split words (ro in roselike and Roche, Mer in Merthyr, Mar in Marquesas, fer in ferocious, Ar in Arctica); pushes toward 'strategy' tokens and steers into 'Strategy strategy' spam.

L26n1811.name: Word starts hal, prof
L26n1811.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word, mainly 'hal' (halos, halibut, halving), 'prof' (professed, proficiency), 'Diff' (diffusion) and 'eff'; pushes toward 'file' and 'download' words and steers into 'download download' spam.

L26n2439.name: Capital word fragments
L26n2439.description: Fires on a capitalized or name-initial fragment inside a split word (TE in INTELLIGENCE, STE in STEAK, A in Antoine and Armagnac); pushes toward consonant-cluster tokens (nt, nd, mb, ll) and steers into 'ndndnd' or 'llll' spam.

L25n2761.name: Surname middle pieces
L25n2761.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split surname or place name (ze in Roozeboom, McInt in McIntire, itting in Whittingham, in in Mackinac); pushes toward 'release' and 'issued' words and steers into 'release issued issued' spam.

L26n2224.name: und word starts
L26n2224.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word, most strongly 'und' (undies, undeniably, undoubtedly), and also 'ry' in apocryphal and 'Bad' in Badlands; pushes toward 'schedule' words and steers into 'schedule schedule' spam.

L26n2101.name: Medical term prefixes
L26n2101.description: Fires on the first piece of a medical or biology compound term (hyper in hypermethylation, odef in immunodeficiency, viral in viral loads, synd in syndromes); pushes toward 'activation' words and steers into 'Activate activation' spam.

L25n561.name: Stems before suffixes
L25n561.description: Fires on a word stem split from its suffix (observ in observance, conserv in conservativeness, persist in persisting, predict in predictability, know in know-how); pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'gether' and 'etheless' and steers into 'gether gether' spam.

L26n2509.name: Proper-name fragments, chart output
L26n2509.description: The first or middle subword piece of a capitalized proper name split into tokens, mostly place names (Te|esside, Gaz|ala, Pen|ryn, Gat|linburg); pushes toward 'chart', 'diagram' and 'graph'.

L26n1323.name: Name fragments, name output
L26n1323.description: Goes negative on the middle or first piece of a split name or long word (Me|vlana, Al|fonso, Mal|awi, tyr|ant, Er|tekin), before its continuation; pushes toward 'name', 'filename' and 'username'.

L26n2078.name: Mid-word fragments, motion output
L26n2078.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, often 'm', 'rem' or 'Em' in words about bodies or machines (tread|mills, wind|mills, rem|oves, Em|otional, gently, physically); pushes toward 'motion', 'motor' and 'movement'.

L26n2933.name: Noun stems, apple/fruit output
L26n2933.description: The stem piece of a plural or compound noun split into tokens, often animal, plant or food words (pige|ons, we|evils, Par|akeet, ind|igo, blo|ating, Z|ebra); pushes toward 'apple' and 'fruit'.

L26n1582.name: Word-stem fragments, account output
L26n1582.description: A mid-word stem piece of a long word split into tokens, right before a suffix such as -ible, -actic, -actor or -ieves (rodu|cible, gal|actic, benef|actor, satisf|actorily, rel|ieves); pushes toward 'account' and 'accounts'.

L26n2974.name: Technical-term starts, speed output
L26n2974.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a technical or medical word split into tokens (ign|ition, nit|rous, sun|block, sn|ippers, rop|enic, Matth|aei); pushes toward 'speed' tokens.

L26n2157.name: St-/ste- fragments, plugin output
L26n2157.description: The 'st', 'ste' or 'str' opening piece of a word split into tokens (ste|amer, Str|oudwater, st|retches, Bridge|stone); pushes toward 'plugin' and 'plugins'.

L26n34.name: Mid-word fragments, ?) output
L26n34.description: Goes negative on a middle piece of a long technical or medical word split into tokens (exh|ales, inhib|itory, noct|urnally, ill|ins); pushes toward ')', '?)' and ')?' closing punctuation.

L25n2834.name: 'the' before cause nouns
L25n2834.description: Goes negative on 'the' or 'a' right before a causal noun such as cause, root, reason or cure, in medical or explanatory text (the| cause of obesity, the| root of the problem); pushes toward 'cause' and 'ca' tokens.

L26n1890.name: Word-initial fragments, explore output
L26n1890.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word or name split into tokens, at the start of a new item or title (Se|baceous, T|endulkar, T|almud, aqu|aculture, t|innitus); pushes toward 'explore' and 'exploration'.

L25n1069.name: 'm'/'rem' fragments, mix output
L25n1069.description: The 'm' or 'rem' piece opening a word split into tokens, in lists of foods, objects and mixing or mashing tasks (m|ango, m|asher, rem|oves, verm|ilion); pushes toward 'mix' and 'mixed'.

L26n2654.name: Term-start fragments, tensor output
L26n2654.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a medical, botanical or technical term split into tokens (intr|avascular, otr|acheitis, Pr|EP, ost|oma, abs|cess, Pr|uning); pushes toward 'tensor' and 'TensorFlow'.

L26n2215.name: Name fragments, closing-quote output
L26n2215.description: Goes negative on a word-start or middle piece inside a proper name split into tokens (Xer|xes, Se|ville, Hert|ford, Res|ervoir, Shi|loh); pushes toward closing quotes and brackets such as ']' and '}'.

L26n1050.name: List-junction tokens, office output
L26n1050.description: The comma, 'and' or 'a' that closes or joins items in a list or pair of noun phrases (Medicare|,, factoring |and| merchant cash, a| consulting group); pushes toward 'office', 'department' and 'staff'.

L26n2000.name: Physical-feature words, wire output
L26n2000.description: The second word of a two-word physical term, e.g. 'bow' in bow shock, 'straight' in straight line, 'deep' in deep drop-offs, 'bike' in bike lanes; pushes toward 'wire' and 'cable'.

L26n354.name: Clause-head onsets, param output
L26n354.description: A grab bag: the token just before a noun or verb phrase head, e.g. 'mando' in 'tomando en cuenta', 'while' before 'exercising', 'God' before 'asked', 'La' before 'Coruña'; pushes toward '(param' and other code parameter tokens.

L26n2113.name: Word-piece starts, brand output
L26n2113.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'rem' in 'removes', 'pl' in 'placentitis', 'Long' in 'Longfellow', 'mon' in 'monolith'; pushes toward 'brand' tokens.

L25n316.name: Unit-prefix pieces, color output
L25n316.description: The piece of a unit or measure word split into tokens, 'mill' in millilitres, 'cent' in centimetres, '1' in 1680, plus '-ize' stems (harmon|ized, optim|isation, util|ized); pushes toward 'color', 'colors' and 'favors'.

L25n907.name: Language-letter C/F, hash output
L25n907.description: Goes negative on the single letter C or F that names a programming language or starts a word (C|++, C|#, F|#, c|umin, c|aramels, f|eta, g|ators); pushes toward '#' tokens.

L26n2513.name: Person-name fragments, science output
L26n2513.description: The first or middle piece of a person's name split into tokens, e.g. 'Raf' in Rafid, 'Borg' in Borglum, 'Schro' in Schroers, 'Mas' in Maslow, 'ah' in Abdu'l-Bahá; pushes toward 'physics', 'chemistry' and 'math'.

L25n2403.name: Split-word fragments, rights output
L25n2403.description: Mid-word pieces of split words and names (izable in customizable, Ob in Obadiah, ra in sauerkraut, Hel in Helens); pushes toward rights, access and permissions.

L26n1292.name: Plant and place pieces
L26n1292.description: Interior pieces of split plant, food and place names (agr in bermudagrass, ax in flaxseed, rd in Córdoba, ost in mangosteen); pushes toward 'segment' tokens.

L26n2325.name: Body and medical word-starts
L26n2325.description: The first piece of a split body-part or medical word (co in cochlea, eyel in eyelids, ang in angina, eb in eyebrow, tum in tumour); pushes toward 'flat' and 'straight'.

L26n540.name: Mid-word fragments, dash output
L26n540.description: Word-internal pieces, often 'ca', 'emb' or 'be' starts (be-zzlement, emb-rittlement, ca-ssonne); pushes hyphen-dash tokens such as '-' and '*-'.

L26n1798.name: Name and nerve-root pieces
L26n1798.description: Word-start or mid-word pieces of names and 'nerve root' terms (nerve, Schenk-ensch-ans, Mel-vin, Sch-); pushes toward 'signal' and 'signals'.

L25n162.name: Latin species-name pieces
L25n162.description: Pieces of split Latin species and place names (Pl-atanus, alex-andri, oph-agus, Alt-ai); pushes toward 'wait' and 'waiting'.

L26n1751.name: European place-name starts
L26n1751.description: The first piece of a split geographic or historical name (And-alusia, West Africa, Rod-inia, Stra-), plus some split chemistry words; pushes toward 'European' and 'EU'.

L25n1549.name: Split word fragments
L25n1549.description: Pieces of split words in mixed domains (Sup-posedly, ground in ground beetles, nap-kins, ic in bactericidal); pushes toward 'cover' and 'coverage'.

L26n1274.name: Title 'of' and fragments
L26n1274.description: 'of' inside institution and journal titles (American Board of Periodontology, Journal of Toxic), plus split word starts (sarc, soy, acc); pushes toward 'Ab' and 'abstract'.

L25n1966.name: Knead stem and fragments
L25n1966.description: The 'kne' stem of kneading and kneel, plus 'Sh' and 'Z' word-starts (kne-ading, kne-ad, Sh-aped); pushes toward 'assume' and 'assumption'.

L26n759.name: Infinitive 'to' and 'wh'
L26n759.description: Word-start 'wh' (whistling, whizz) and 'car' or 'auto' pieces, plus 'to' before an infinitive verb after a noun (users to browse); pushes toward 'book' and 'books'.

L26n1422.name: f-start word fragments
L26n1422.description: The short 'f' or 'conf', 'dis' piece that begins a split word (f-athom, f-iddled, f-ashions, conf-ute, self-dis-covery); pushes toward 'discover' and 'discovery'.

L26n2595.name: Name-start pieces
L26n2595.description: The first piece of a split proper name (Sin-tra, Mohen-jo-daro, Ru-shd, Fab-ergé); pushes toward 'continue' and 'continued'.

L25n517.name: Festival and holiday words
L25n517.description: Festival, holiday and folk word-starts (F in Festival of Lights, holiday cheer, folk, vacation); pushes toward 'delight', 'joy' and 'beautiful'.

L26n369.name: Digit one and Sp-starts
L26n369.description: The digit '1' or '2' opening a recipe quantity or list item, and 'Sp' word-starts (Spinal, Spicy); pushes toward the ellipsis '…'.

L26n2634.name: Italian place-name pieces
L26n2634.description: Pieces of Italian and Pisan place or artist names (Pisa, Sicily, Italy, Magg-iolo); pushes toward no clear token, and steering yields blank runs.

L26n614.name: Given first names
L26n614.description: The first token of a person's given name, often split (En-ola, Ben-ito, Yo-ko, Yehu-da); pushes toward first names such as Charles, Thomas and William.

L26n1942.name: Mid-word pieces, align output
L26n1942.description: Mid-word pieces of split words (absor-ber, dri-est, scr-apping, ar-mpits, ratio-cinative); pushes toward 'align' and 'alignment'.

L26n2087.name: Word-start pieces, break output
L26n2087.description: The first piece of a split word or name, often 'pa' in palettes or 'bra' in braids (Ish-iguro, Dalma-u); pushes toward 'break' and 'breaks'.

L26n1660.name: Ar and Mer word-starts
L26n1660.description: Word-start pieces 'Mer' and 'Ar' in names and terms (Merino, Archaeology, Arthritis, arribadas); pushes toward 'animal' and 'animals'.

L26n2180.name: Mid-word subword pieces
L26n2180.description: Goes negative on a non-final piece of a word split into tokens, mostly medical terms and names (arr|yth|mia, Mah|al, hypopar|athy|roidism, Di|ets). Pushes toward 'dist' fragments; steering spams 'Dist'.

L25n2430.name: Word-start pieces, 'extract' output
L25n2430.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a split word, often starting 'extr', 'exc' or 'sc' (extr|icably, Exc|avation, -sc|ience, Esc|abeche). Pushes toward 'extract' and 'fetch'; steering spams 'Extract'.

L26n2910.name: Mid-name pieces, 'cat' output
L26n2910.description: Goes negative on a non-final piece of a name or technical term split into tokens (S|ita in Ramayana, Z|eld|ovich, Vlas|chenko, Polyc|yclic, neonic|otinoid). Pushes toward 'cat'/'category' fragments; steering spams 'Cat'.

L26n2853.name: N and 'orn' pieces
L26n2853.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a split word or name, strongest on a capital N or 'orn' (Kona N, N|ayarit, orn|amental, An|tonov, KwaZulu-N|atal). Pushes toward 'gradient'/'grad'; steering spams 'gradient'.

L26n2889.name: Titus and split-word pieces
L26n2889.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a split word, most often 'Tit' in Titus (Tit|us Andronicus, Emperor Tit|us), and also 'clus', 'sou' and 'com' (sar|com|as). Writes 'install'/'installation'; steering spams 'Install'.

L26n999.name: 'hot' and food-list pieces
L26n999.description: Goes positive on 'hot' (hot chocolate, hot water, hot sauce) and on non-final pieces of food or item words in lists (m|ango, B|ites, t|ummy, ind|igo). Writes 'consume'/'consumption'; steering spams 'Consum'.

L26n981.name: 'the' before named entities
L26n981.description: Goes negative on 'the' (and 'in', 'of') right before a proper noun or institution in history or news text (the former Soviet Union, the Thatcher family, the Ottoman, the British). Writes tech names (Python, Linux, Android); steering spams 'Python' or 'Earth'.

L25n2311.name: Surname middle pieces
L25n2311.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a split surname (Hotam|is|ligil, Mel|vin, Me|aux, Hu|izinga, Herbert Grü|newald, Bot|anik). Writes 'quant'/'quantity'; steering spams 'Quant'.

L26n442.name: Word starts, suffix output
L26n442.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a split word or name (Cho|osing, Freed|land, Crus|ade, Grad|uates, Har|bor) and on clause-opening words such as 'According' and 'View'. Writes word endings (-ically, -ly, -theless); steering loops on 'ically'.

L26n2488.name: Name pieces and 'too/very'
L26n2488.description: Goes negative on a non-final piece of a split name (Tim|ur, Kut|cher, Long|fellow, Qut|b) and on intensifiers before an adjective ('too low', 'too much', 'very red'). Writes 'depth'/'deep'; steering spams 'deep'.

L26n2859.name: Surname and place-name pieces
L26n2859.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split surname or place name, usually after a first name or title (Donna Ar|nett, Leth Jø|rgensen, Dr. Fa|uci, Nan|aimo, Ro|che). Writes 'branch'/'trace'; steering spams 'Branch'.

L26n421.name: Idiom-final words
L26n421.description: Goes negative on the key noun or adjective that ends a short idiom or dictionary-style phrase ('a law unto themselves', 'Egypt', 'the majority', 'a phenomenon', 'hurt', 'efficiently'). Writes closing code tokens such as '):' and '**)'; steering barely changes the prose.

L26n1236.name: Split-word pieces, 'bank' output
L26n1236.description: Goes negative on a non-final piece of a split word or name (Ge|ob|acter, Charal|amb|os, Yud|hoyono, Dog|ecoin, F|irms, L|AMP) and on 'lowest' in 'lowest monthly payments'. Writes 'bank'/'banking'; steering spams 'Bank'.

L26n893.name: Acronym openers after '('
L26n893.description: Goes positive on the first letters of an acronym, especially right after an opening '(' (UNC, UBRC, CERU, RVUSD, KCCU), and on non-final pieces of words like cantal|ou|pe. Writes short starts such as 'Cu', 'du', 'Lu'; steering spams 'Lu' or 'Cu'.

L25n2623.name: Equipment noun in compounds
L25n2623.description: Goes positive on the hardware or setup noun in a machine description (gun turret, landing gear, all-wheel-drive, lighting conditions, turbine-generator, twin-turreted). Writes 'setup', 'layout' and 'configuration'; steering spams 'setup'.

L26n1627.name: Word before house/company
L26n1627.description: Goes positive on the modifier word right before a building or business noun (steak|house, clearing|house, publishing company, thrift store, tea plantation). Writes 'house'/'House'; steering spams 'House'.

L26n2186.name: Place-name first pieces
L26n2186.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a split place name (And|alusia, Ha|ucourt, G|undisapur, Pe|enemunde, G|uelph). Writes 'height'/'heights'; steering spams 'Height'.

L26n894.name: Place-name second pieces
L26n894.description: Goes positive on the second piece of a split place name, often UK or US towns (Vicks|burg, Middles|brough, Te|ess|ide, Inver|ke|ithing, K|wa|Zulu). Writes 'Int'/'Bool'/'Integer' type names; steering spams 'Int'.

L26n2929.name: 'b' starts, 'beta' output
L26n2929.description: Goes negative on a non-final piece that starts with 'b' or 'emb' (grey-b|rown, B|âtard, emb|arks, emb|rittlement, seab|irds, B|icycles). Writes 'beta'/'bet'; steering spams 'Beta'.

L26n2653.name: Long-word stem pieces
L26n2653.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a long technical or legal word (cov|ariant, constit|uting, emb|rittlement, mach|ined, bas|mati, av|ascular). Writes 'poll'/'voting'; steering spams 'Poll'.

L26n562.name: Clause-end and list-start boundaries
L26n562.description: Fires on the period or comma that closes an instruction or list item, and on the first token of a numbered answer right after the empty think block. Pushes the model toward Spanish/Italian openers ('En', 'El', 'Es').

L26n1628.name: Word-initial fragments before completion
L26n1628.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a longer word split into tokens, such as 'dis' in 'disinfected', 'sym' in 'symphony', 'cyst' in 'cysteine', 'Myst' in 'Mysticism'. Pushes toward 'band', 'music', 'song'.

L26n1532.name: Material or substance nouns
L26n1532.description: Fires on the substance or material noun in a list or 'of/with' phrase (compost, foam, fire, cumin, animal protein). Pushes toward 'metal', 'fabric' and 'manufacturing'.

L26n1091.name: Name starts before examples
L26n1091.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a proper name or noun split into tokens, such as 'Anch' in Anchorage and anchovies, 'Bo' in Bois Blanc and boars, 'esc' in escabeche. Pushes toward 'example', 'demonstrate', 'illustrate'.

L25n7.name: Formal title name fragments
L25n7.description: Fires on the capital or first piece of a title or proper name inside a long formal phrase ('Royal' in 'His Royal Highness', 'Mart' in Martel, 'Cre' in Cremesi), and weakly on chat-template header tokens. Pushes toward code braces and string closers ('{', '({', '?");').

L26n2335.name: Short word-start fragments
L26n2335.description: Fires on a short first fragment of a word split across tokens, mostly 'Rec' in recycling, 'ch' in chicken and Chaco, 'Phar' in Pharrell, 'oc' in radiocarbon. Pushes toward 'innovation', 'innovative' and 'creativity'.

L25n2821.name: Proper name capital starts
L25n2821.description: Fires on the capital letter or first piece of a proper name ('N' in Nayarit and Nakhon, 'M' in Middlesbrough, 'Mart' in Martel, 'Cal' in Calhoun, '-N' in PDD-NOS). Pushes toward 'primary' and 'secondary'.

L26n743.name: Mid-compound technical fragments
L26n743.description: Goes negative on the second or middle piece of a compound scientific or medical term split into tokens, such as 'leasing' in releasing, 'at' in nematocyst, 'hyper' in hyperacusis, 'xy' in hydroxydeoxyguanosine, 'vir' in retrovirus. Pushes toward 'property' and 'properties'.

L26n269.name: Adjective before technical noun
L26n269.description: Fires on the modifier right before a technical head noun ('smooth' in smooth muscle, 'near' in near-infrared, 'heel' in heel pain), and on word-start 'mim' in mimicking. Pushes toward 'wait' and 'asynchronous'.

L26n1869.name: Biology word leading pieces
L26n1869.description: Goes negative on the leading piece of a long biology or medical word split into tokens, such as 'tr' in protruding, 'pr' in prokaryotes, 'cr' in crumbly, 'Micro' in microclots, 'Mon' in Monocotyledoneae. Pushes toward 'liquid' and 'fluid'.

L26n284.name: Numbers and measurement parentheses
L26n284.description: Fires on numerals, percent signs and opening parentheses in quantitative text ('95%' in confidence intervals, '60mm (2.36 in)', '15.6 °C'). Pushes toward time-period words 'month', 'week', 'year' and 'holiday'.

L25n636.name: Fiction and falsehood word-starts
L25n636.description: Goes negative on the 'F' of 'Fiction' in fact-versus-fiction lists, and on word starts such as 'dis' (disprove, indisputably), 'f' (fad, farsighted) and 'proph' (prophesied). Pushes toward 'true', 'false' and 'truth'.

L26n181.name: Percentages in statistics reporting
L26n181.description: Fires on the percent sign and separators in statistical reporting, especially '%' in 95% confidence intervals and ';' in relative-risk results. Pushes toward 'ratio', 'rate' and 'percentage'.

L26n2778.name: Historical proper name starts
L26n2778.description: Fires on the first letter or fragment of an ancient or historical proper name ('H' in Hellenistic and Hittite, 'X' in Xerxes, 'T' in Tiberius, 'Ram' in Ramkhamhaeng). Pushes toward 'probability'.

L26n1133.name: Name starts, word stems
L26n1133.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a place or person name and on some word stems ('Pou' in Poulsbo, 'Har' in Harvard, 'W' in Waltham, 'patch' in patchy, '-w' in hard-wiring). Pushes toward 'labor' and 'workers'.

L26n1406.name: Place-name fragments
L26n1406.description: Goes negative on the first or middle piece of a place or person name split into tokens ('Nem' in Nemadji, 'Laf' in Lafitte, 'ant' in Nantawarrina, 'Bab' in Bab el Mandeb, 'Me' in Meaux). Pushes toward 'letter' and 'letters'.

L25n944.name: Disease-term word fragments
L25n944.description: Goes negative on the consonant-led piece of a word split into tokens, often in disease and medical terms ('R' in rickets, 'rr' in seborrhea, 'des' in desensitized, 'bs' in Klebsiella, 'w' in wobbling). Pushes toward 'delay' and 'blocking'.

L26n633.name: Latin and proper-name starts
L26n633.description: Goes negative on the first or middle piece of a Latin-root or proper name split across tokens (Platanus, Elaeis, Acidithiobacillus, Stangeria, 'N' in Nishi Amane). Pushes toward 'para' and 'pour'.

L26n2396.name: Second part of names
L26n2396.description: Goes negative on the fragment that starts the second part of a multi-part name or split word ('Bl' in Pine Bluff, 'Clear' in Creedence Clearwater, 'Scott' in Coretta Scott King, 'sil' in silhouettes). Pushes toward 'alternative'.

L25n3024.name: f-initial technical word starts
L25n3024.description: Goes negative on the start of a word split into tokens, often beginning with 'f' or 'fe' ('fe' in fevers and febrile, 'f' in fussy, 'F' in FIV), plus 'yc' in sycamore. Pushes toward 'preference', 'favor' and 'priority'.

L26n15.name: Split-word piece → digits
L26n15.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a word or name split into several tokens (sou|ps, Camb|io, Rest|all, Share|-Alike), mid-word; pushes digit tokens 0-9.

L25n1364.name: Tech-stack link → node
L25n1364.description: Fires on 'and', 'using' or 'in' right after a programming tech name (Node.js, React, Flask, Gatsby, PHP) in coding-task prompts; pushes 'node' and 'Node' tokens.

L26n782.name: Diffuse; writes capital M
L26n782.description: Diffuse: fires on list dashes and colons, sentence-final periods, and the second word of multi-word terms (Ice Storm, High Blood Pressure, Stockholders); pushes capital-M tokens 'M', 'Mi', 'My'.

L25n1440.name: Name-start piece → %
L25n1440.description: Fires on the early subword piece of a split proper name (Pat|agonia, Th|ammarat, Luc|idchart, N|akhon) and on command starts like 'sudo yum'; pushes printf-style placeholders '%', '%{', '{}'.

L26n685.name: Prefix 'an' → suffixes
L26n685.description: Fires on 'an' or 'An' opening a word split into pieces (an|esthetic, an|emia, An|archism, an|emones, An|arthritis) and on sentence-initial 'The', 'At', 'In'; pushes suffix pieces '-ed', '-est', '-ize', '-ise'.

L26n546.name: Compound middle, 'c' onset
L26n546.description: Fires on a piece in the middle of a hyphenated or split compound (50-_Start-ups, sub-spec-ies, IP (Internet), retrie-vers, behind-the-scenes) and on ALL-CAPS function words; pushes word-start 'c', 'cl', 'cr', 'cur' tokens.

L26n923.name: Mid-name piece → particle
L26n923.description: Fires on the middle piece of a long multi-token proper noun or loanword (Mp|um|alanga, ts|un|ami, Mund|ial, loco|mot|ives, Dar|es|Salaam); pushes 'particle', 'particles' and 'Physics'.

L25n1111.name: Split-word piece → 'perfect'
L25n1111.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of split words (Ps|oph|odes, cam|phor, Fem|ale) and on intensifiers 'Very', 'pretty', 'particularly', 'Grand'; pushes evaluative 'perfect', 'ideal' and 'good'.

L26n1398.name: Name piece → 'bar'
L26n1398.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a split proper name or UI word (Middles|b|rough, Aer|ob|iotic, Boul|ton, H|all thrusters) and on 'URL', 'menu', 'browser'; pushes 'bar', 'Bar' and 'bars'.

L26n1107.name: Name second piece, report
L26n1107.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a multi-token person or place name (Coretta Scott, Bryn M|aw|r, H|ert|ford, Ted Hughes, Mc|Int|osh) and on 'dec' in decarbonise; pushes 'report', 'Report' and 'reports'.

L26n2820.name: Short word start, 'guide'
L26n2820.description: Fires on a short fragment that opens a split word, often one or two letters after a space (Alka-Selt|zer, o|asis, O|phioglossaceae, Le|ashes, le|thal); pushes 'guide', 'guidance' and 'instructions'.

L26n2247.name: Hyphen-split c/k → city
L26n2247.description: Fires on a 'c' or 'k' that starts the second half of a hyphenated or split word (foot-|candle, iso-c|andlepower, close-|knit, C|nidus, /c|ities); pushes 'city', 'cities', 'urban' and 'town'.

L25n113.name: mol/ret fragments → braces
L25n113.description: Fires on word-start fragments 'mol' (mol|ars, mol|ting) and 'ret' (ret|arded, ret|aliation), and on '+++NEW+++' banner tokens; pushes LaTeX-style backslash and brace tokens.

L26n860.name: Finance terms → fund/spend
L26n860.description: Fires on finance and loan vocabulary (APR, interest rate, World Bank, average rate of return, inflation, 'your' before 'interest rate'); pushes 'fund', 'funds', 'spend', 'spending' and 'funding'.

L26n2792.name: Stem pieces → 'conf'
L26n2792.description: Fires on word-start pieces of split words, mostly 'sur', 'cur', 'Cons', 'contr' and 'Vas' (sur|ges, cur|iosities, Cons|ensus, Vas|ari); pushes 'conf', '(conf', 'confidence' and 'trust'.

L26n21.name: Role nouns and commas
L26n21.description: Fires on person-role nouns (Chancellor, physicist, historian, minister, writer, bishop) and on commas or arrows inside lists and equations; steered output drops its spaces and fills with word-end fragments.

L26n271.name: Mid-phrase words → cancel
L26n271.description: Diffuse: fires on mid-phrase words right before a noun or verb ('Fast' in Fast Market Research, 'at' birth, weight loss, skin, 'steadily', 'rapid'); pushes 'delete', 'cancel', 'removal', 'decline' and 'logout'.

L26n3048.name: Modal before verb, 'pick'
L26n3048.description: Fires on a modal or infinitive word ('can', 'to', 'may', 'must', 'be', 'that') right after a noun subject and before a bare verb (sensors that can communicate, heart rate may increase); pushes the verb 'pick'.

L26n1497.name: Compound prefix → light
L26n1497.description: Fires on the prefix piece of a split or hyphenated word (lact|ose, polym|er, nan|ofabrication, non-|natives, green-|lipped, U|plink); pushes 'light', 'Light', 'optical', 'phot' and 'photon'.

L26n1086.name: Split stem → 'name'
L26n1086.description: Fires on the stem piece that opens a split word (Plate|lets, Organ|izational, germ|plasm, embry|onic, pal|atability); pushes 'name', '_name', 'ID' and 'NAME'.

L25n2229.name: Articles before proper names
L25n2229.description: Fires on 'the', 'and' or a name-piece right before or inside a proper noun (the Erechtheion, Hiroshima and Nagasaki, Perna); pushes toward 'original' and 'raw'.

L26n934.name: Surname and name-piece tokens
L26n934.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a multi-token person, place or organisation name (Long in Longfellow or Long Island, Mel in Melvin, St in St. Louis); pushes toward 'stone', 'wood' and 'river'.

L26n1744.name: Mid-word stems, talk write
L26n1744.description: Fires on a stem piece of a word split across tokens (ret in retelling, NG in MESSENGER, ars in farsighted, yt in fairytale, self before -talk); pushes toward 'talk', 'speaking' and 'dialog'.

L26n719.name: Prefix and hyphen joints
L26n719.description: Fires on the token right after a hyphen or on a word-opening prefix piece (dis, un, sub, bio, hydro, str), often just after an opening quote; pushes toward directional particles 'up', 'out', 'away' and 'down'.

L26n1759.name: Scientific word fragments
L26n1759.description: Fires on the second piece of a Latin or Greek scientific or taxonomic word (oph in Psophodes, hyp in hypodermis, heter in heterosporous, od in Rhododendron, H in Hellenic); pushes toward 'sex' and 'sexual'.

L26n618.name: Given-name and surname starts
L26n618.description: Fires on the first token of a person's given name or surname in a multi-token name (Jean in Jean Lafitte, Gour in Gourdie, Ram in Rajesh, Scott in Coretta Scott King); pushes toward '::' filler.

L26n2521.name: Word-initial Al/Ar/Az pieces
L26n2521.description: Fires on short word-opening pieces like Al, Ar, Az and ḥ that start a word split into tokens, mostly in Andalusian, olive, Arabic and azalea names; pushes toward 'boundary' and 'border'.

L25n1493.name: Adjective stems before -ly
L25n1493.description: Fires on an adjective or noun stem that takes a suffix like -ly, -ness or -al (heart in heartbroken, natural, moral, mental, racial), and on some first names like Richard; pushes toward '-ly' and '-ness' endings.

L25n2194.name: Shell and sudo commands
L25n2194.description: Fires on command-line and install-tutorial tokens (-p in get-pip.py, NOPASSWD, sudo, yum, execute) and on pieces inside command or package names; pushes toward 'output', 'exit' and 'export'.

L26n317.name: Think-tag start, filler
L26n317.description: Fires on the '<think>' token that opens the assistant's reply in chat-template prompts (and on 'repetition' in system prompts); pushes toward underscore lines, blank lines and '[...]' filler.

L26n2657.name: con-/contr- word openers
L26n2657.description: Fires on the opening fragment of a word split into tokens, especially con, contr, cont and ab (contortionists, contrived, abstraction, Corn in cornrows); pushes toward 'exchange' and 'trade'.

L26n2499.name: Air, jet, stream words
L26n2499.description: Fires on the start of flow and air words split into tokens (jet in jet streams, air in air performance curves, Gulf before Stream, Therm in Thermopylae); pushes toward 'stream' and 'streams'.

L25n1166.name: Dates: 'on' and weekdays
L25n1166.description: Fires on 'on' before a weekday or date and on day, month and year digits in news datelines (on Monday, on June 6, 2007, Aug 7, 2012); pushes toward month names such as Sep, Oct, Jul and Nov.

L26n876.name: Word-initial consonant clusters
L26n876.description: Fires on the opening consonant fragment of a word split into tokens (St in Stewardship, Cons in constable, Gl in Gorilla Glue, Pr in pruning); pushes toward closing code brackets like ']))' and '])'.

L25n1808.name: 'code' and size-word pieces
L25n1808.description: Fires on the word 'code' in coding requests and on size or part words (vast, small, Cod, chunk-like pieces); pushes toward 'segment', 'section', 'chunk' and 'fragment'.

L26n1134.name: Word-internal 're' prefix pieces
L26n1134.description: Fires on 're' and rem, res or rom pieces that open a word split into tokens (ique in riqueza, -re in self-reliance and dose-reduction, irre in irreparable); pushes toward 'lab' and 'laboratory'.

L25n1390.name: Multi-token surname starts
L25n1390.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token surname or place name (Hersch in Lauterpacht, Kos in Kosrae, Kel in Kelentric, Nes in Nesbitt, Sebast in Sebastián); pushes toward 'platform' and 'platforms'.

L26n2591.name: Proper-noun starts, months
L26n2591.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalised name or month (Mer in Merlin or Merck, Per in Perseus, Jan in January, Dor in Dorset); pushes toward 'May' and other month names.

L25n1492.name: Legal/official status words
L25n1492.description: Fires on status words that qualify a legal, official or regulatory noun (officially, federally registered, protected areas, legal guardian, National); pushes toward 'design' and 'den'.

L26n2047.name: Split-name first pieces
L26n2047.description: Fires on the first fragment of a multi-token proper name (Nem in Nemadji, Dum in Dumfries, Zap in Zapata, Vit in Vitória) and on bub in bubonic; pushes toward 'transfer' and 'transfers'.

L25n1524.name: Noun-fragment starts in lists
L25n1524.description: Fires on the first piece of a noun split into several tokens, e.g. 'mac' in macaws, 'cor' in coral, 'Por' in Porifera, 'mang' in mangostana, 'Cor' in Coruña, mostly inside lists of animals, plants or places. Pushes toward code-assignment tokens like '=k' and '=p'; steering gives mostly noise.

L25n645.name: Mid-word stem before suffix
L25n645.description: Fires on the middle piece of a long word split into several tokens, e.g. 'vir' in retro-vir-uses, 'Hor' in Horrible and horizons, 'ger' in germline, 'blo' and 'imper'. It sits just before a word ending; pushing it up writes suffixes like -ation, -ive and -ures, and steering gives garbled '-ination' words.

L26n466.name: Proper-name first fragment
L26n466.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalized name or split word, e.g. 'La' in La Coupole, 'Koh' in Kohli, 'Le' in Ledenhall, 'lif' in lifeguards, 'phot' in photovoltaic. Pushes toward 'possible' and 'available'; steered text collapses into repeated 'Available possible'.

L26n2617.name: Room and space sufficiency
L26n2617.description: Goes negative on words about space or enough amount: 'free' in 'free space', 'provide' in 'provide room', 'ample', 'enough', 'much', 'lot', and the 'is' in 'there is a need'. Pushing it negative makes the model repeat 'room'.

L25n882.name: Words opening noun phrases
L25n882.description: Goes negative on the article or preposition that opens a new noun phrase: 'A' in 'A network is', 'a' in 'apply a mulch', 'as' in 'such as:', 'on' in 'Follow on Facebook'. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'summary' and 'overview'.

L26n1510.name: Verb-complement lead-in words
L26n1510.description: Goes negative on a word that sets up a following verb or object: 'get' and 'got' in 'help your child get' and 'got the hang', 'you' in 'the things you normally', 'so' in 'so fond', 'more' in 'more excited', 'a' in 'buy a house'. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'used' and 'usage'.

L26n258.name: Punctuation joining term parts
L26n258.description: Fires on punctuation that glues parts of one term together: the '(' before a metric conversion, '://' in URLs, the hyphen in 'lacto-fermentation', the apostrophe in 'Flora d'Italia', and the 'bio' or 'gastro' starts of compounds. Pushes toward word-ending suffix tokens like -er, -ed, -en, -ing; steering gives garbled 'enenen' strings.

L26n962.name: Proper-noun first fragment
L26n962.description: Goes negative on the first fragment of a proper noun split into pieces, strongest on 'Vers' in Versailles and 'Pers' in Persians, also 'Ger' in Gertrude, 'Her' in Herlyne, 'Mer' and 'Sardis'. Pushing it negative makes the model output 'site' and 'sites'.

L26n623.name: Infinitive 'to' before verb
L26n623.description: Fires on 'to', 'can', 'will' or 'not' right before a bare verb, e.g. 'trials to' test, 'used to' get, 'can' use, 'will' install, 'to' find. Pushes the model to predict a verb such as test, train or check; steering gives 'test train' loops.

L25n1708.name: Name-start 'Mer' and 'Mor'
L25n1708.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name, most strongly 'Mer' in Merlins, Merck and Merthyr, 'Mor' in Moravian and Morley, and 'ev' in evoke and evinced. Pushes toward 'clear', 'clearly' and 'explicit'; steering gives 'clearly visible' loops.

L26n2281.name: Rare name continuation pieces
L26n2281.description: Goes negative on a sub-token inside a rare name or loanword, e.g. 'ñ' in Piñera, 'Pic' in Picudas, 'Maj' in Majorelle, 'Ram' in Rambla, 'ist' in armistice, 'Fab' in Fabergé. Pushing it negative makes the model output 'remote' and 'far'.

L26n1079.name: Capital letter starting names
L26n1079.description: Goes negative on a capital letter or short first piece that starts a name or acronym, e.g. 'H' in Houdon, 'H' in HSPH and Hensinger, 'Sch' in Schwann and Schiffman, 'F' in FACC, 'l' in lifestyle. Pushing it negative makes the model output long runs of dashes.

L25n252.name: Inside formulas, code args
L25n252.description: Fires on the first token inside a formula, function call or config string, e.g. '(x' in h(x) = y, the '4' in =(B4+B35), 'category=' in a URL, 'ALL' in a sudoers line, '/' in a closing tag. Pushes toward '=' assignment tokens; steering gives a loose story with little clear effect.

L26n2935.name: Name piece after of/the
L26n2935.description: Fires on a middle piece of a multi-token proper name or rare noun, e.g. 'Ho' in Hojiblanca, 'Ja' in Jaén, 'Lak' in Lakshmi, 'Sah' in Sahib, 'hon' in honours, 'azar' in Almazaras. Pushes toward 'plot' and 'plots'; steering loops the word 'plot'.

L26n2190.name: Onset of long words
L26n2190.description: Fires on the first 2-3 letters of a longer word split into pieces, strongest on 'Gr' in Grating, 'qu' in quasar, 'gr' in grail and gravitational, 'ab' in abstractions, 'cl' in clonemates. Pushes toward 'star' and 'stars'; steering gives 'star star' loops.

L26n2152.name: 'a' after 'There are'
L26n2152.description: Goes negative on the indefinite article 'a' right after 'There are' or 'in a series', e.g. 'There are a few', 'There are a lot', 'one in a series'. It reads a quantity phrase, but pushing it negative writes 'string' and 'strings'.

L25n550.name: Australia, NZ, exam names
L25n550.description: Fires on Australian and New Zealand place names and exam-board names, e.g. 'New' in New Zealand, 'NSW', 'Queensland', 'Australia', and 'SE' and 'excel' in GCSE and Edexcel. Pushes toward word fragments such as 'avored' and 'umor'; steering gives 'gray gray' and 'avored' loops.

L26n80.name: Word starts and quote-comma
L26n80.description: Fires on a short word-start piece such as 'rel' in relieves and relays, 'st' in stews and stumbles, or 'as' in 'such as', and on commas after list items. Pushes toward semicolon-quote-comma punctuation; steering floods the output with commas and semicolons.

L26n1299.name: 'br' onset of bruxism
L26n1299.description: Fires on the first two letters of a split word, strongest on 'br' in bruxism (teeth grinding) and 'Br' in Brunsbüttel, and also on 'Ar' in Arbequina, 'Gh' in Ghafiqi and 'b' in Middlesbrough. Pushes toward 'company' and 'companies'; steering gives 'company' loops.

L25n976.name: Preposition after a noun
L25n976.description: Goes negative on the preposition or verb that follows a noun phrase, e.g. 'over' in 'heat over medium heat', 'of' in 'War of 1812', 'in' in 'moves in a straight line', 'lie' in 'patients lie on', plus mid-word pieces like 'es' in Thespians. Pushing it negative makes the model output 'unknown' and 'empty'.

L26n1646.name: Mid-word fragment, programming
L26n1646.description: Strongly positive on a middle piece of a rare word split into tokens (e.g. 'gh' in sorghum, 'g' in polygamy, 'rid' in ridleys, 'pest' in pest control); steering it up pushes toward 'programming' and 'logging'.

L26n828.name: Word-continuation fragment, closing parens
L26n828.description: Strongly positive on a short subword fragment that continues a split word (e.g. '-h' in self-harm, '-g' in guess, 'Char' in Charon, 'G' in Gutzon); steering it up pushes toward closing code tokens like ')' and '`). Effect on prose is weak.

L25n2977.name: Tech tool name, version
L25n2977.description: Strongly positive on the connective or first piece of a software or tool name in tech-task prompts (e.g. 'with' after 'familiarity', 'As' in Asana, 'G' in Gatsby, 'Software'); steering it up pushes toward 'version'.

L26n2607.name: Proper-noun opener, property
L26n2607.description: Strongly positive on the first subword of a capitalised name or word still being spelled out (e.g. 'T' in Tete, 'Bo' in Bois Blanc, 'spe' in spears, 'Y' in Yogyakarta, 'blo' in blooming); steering it up pushes toward 'property' and 'properties'.

L25n24.name: Preposition before complement, yes
L25n24.description: Strongly negative on a preposition that opens a complement after a verb or noun (e.g. 'from' in launched from Cape Canaveral, 'at' in professor at, 'as' in known as, 'of' in specificity of) and on 'yes' in parentheses; steering it negative pushes toward code brackets like ':' and '()]'.

L26n518.name: Name piece, screen dialog
L26n518.description: Strongly negative on the middle piece of a split proper name or technical term (e.g. 'Mah' in Taj Mahal, 'Maz' in Mazaheri, 'Geh' in Gehrig, 'Gar' in Garuda, 'Woz' in Wozniak); steering it negative pushes toward 'screen', 'dialog' and GUI words.

L26n1716.name: Name piece, past-tense did
L26n1716.description: Strongly negative on a name's middle piece (e.g. 'Pan' in Panaridus, 'Hash' in Hashem, 'Hos' in Hosfeld) and on 'and' or 'or' joining two verb phrases ('and was ready', 'or abridged'); steering it negative pushes toward past-tense verbs like 'did', 'came' and 'took'.

L26n809.name: Digit inside a number
L26n809.description: Strongly negative on a non-leading digit inside a multi-digit quantity (e.g. the '6' in −286 kJ, the '0' in 1360 °C, the '7' in 7 km), and on 'Chapter', 'Section' and 'Figure' headers; steering it negative pushes toward closing quote and bracket tokens like '];' and ']'.

L26n985.name: Institution-name opener, economic
L26n985.description: Strongly negative on the first word of an institution or title name (e.g. 'World' in World Bank, 'American' in American Journal, 'war' in war cabinet); steering it negative pushes toward 'economic' and 'economy'.

L26n722.name: Modal can before effect
L26n722.description: Strongly negative on 'can' or 'will' right after a subject in a claim about an impact or risk (e.g. 'screen time can', 'social media can', 'thinning too much can', 'will lead'); steering it negative pushes toward 'achieve' and 'achieved'.

L25n2158.name: Relative 'that' and modal
L25n2158.description: Strongly negative on 'that' opening a relative clause after a noun (e.g. 'a tumour that affects', 'jobs that will be generated') and on 'will' or 'may' after a subject; steering it negative pushes toward 'result' and 'results'.

L25n1823.name: Check, fact versus fiction
L25n1823.description: Strongly negative on the word after a check or verify instruction and on 'Fact' in 'Fact versus Fiction' lists (e.g. 'self' in self-checking, 'click' after 'then', 'grammar' in grammar checker); steering it negative pushes toward 'check' tokens.

L26n1473.name: Chemical prefix chlor-, hydro-
L26n1473.description: Strongly negative on the opening piece of a chemistry or water-quality word split into tokens (e.g. 'chlor' in chlorides, 'hydro' in hydrogen, 'cyst' in polycystic, 'rom' in dichromate); steering it negative pushes toward 'Dis'-prefixed tokens.

L26n528.name: Device or attribute noun
L26n528.description: Strongly positive on the first piece of a noun naming a device or measured attribute after a modifier (e.g. 'bl' in blower speed, 'cutting' forces, 'closing' fees, 'blo' in bloating); steering it up pushes toward 'price', 'temperature' and 'age'.

L26n2828.name: Name start after of/at
L26n2828.description: Strongly positive on the first subword of a proper noun or term right after 'of', 'at' or 'the' (e.g. 'Hash' in messenger of Hashem, 'Mag' in died at Marrakesh, 'Mun' in Minister of Munitions, 'Ast' in Astola); steering it up pushes toward 'translation' and 'translate'.
L26n2828.name_orig: Name start after of or at

L26n922.name: Place-name subword, sent
L26n922.description: Strongly negative on a mid-word subword of a place name or long word (e.g. 'Maj' in Majorelle, 'Mes' in Mesopotamia, 'Mad' in Madison, 'reck' in reckoned); steering it negative pushes toward 'sent' tokens.

L26n1080.name: Place-name opener, above below
L26n1080.description: Strongly negative on the first token of a place name after 'in', 'at' or 'from' (e.g. 'Cape' in Cape Town, 'Anch' in Anchorage, 'Nan' in Nanaimo, 'Ang' in Angolan, 'Kap' in Kapiri); steering it negative pushes toward 'above' and 'below'.

L25n865.name: Rare-name first piece, braces
L25n865.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a rare multi-token name or long word (e.g. 'Ar' in Delftia acidovorans, 'Tur' in Turbine Hall, 'Nav' in Navajo, 'Zam' in Zambezi, 'Mult' in multifunctional); steering it negative pushes toward '{' brace tokens.

L26n1765.name: Blood, component
L26n1765.description: Strongly negative on 'blood' in medical text (e.g. 'blood vessels', 'blood-brain barrier', 'blood clot', 'blood flow'); steering it negative pushes toward 'component' tokens.

L26n666.name: Name start, pattern
L26n666.description: Strongly negative on the first subword of a place or person name (e.g. 'Suk' in Sukhpur, 'Wak' in Wakayama, 'Ash' in Ashkelon, 'Rab' in Rabier, 'Kra' in Kraig); steering it negative pushes toward 'pattern' tokens.

L25n2254.name: hash / digest word
L25n2254.description: Fires on the word 'hash' (and 'hashing', 'hash function', 'hash joins'), peaking on 'hash' itself and on the token after 'a' or 'the' in hash contexts. Pushes the model to write 'hash', 'MD' and 'md'.

L26n635.name: mid-word subword fragments
L26n635.description: Goes strongly negative on the second or later piece of a word split into tokens, mostly technical words and names ('mac' in macrolides, 'Ret' in Retriever, 'sn' in snippers, 'Car' in Carica). Pushes toward closing quote marks.

L26n394.name: SQL/code syntax keywords
L26n394.description: Fires on a keyword or symbol at a syntax boundary in SQL and code: 'OFFSET' after 'LIMIT n', 'BY' after 'ORDER', '=(' in formulas, '<' in comparisons. Pushes toward code identifiers such as addr, seq, expr and pos.

L25n1915.name: proper-name first fragments
L25n1915.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a proper name or rare word split into tokens ('Par' in Parthenon and parakeets, 'Rush' in Ibn Rushd, 'ep' in epigenetics, 'Dal' in Dalmau). Pushes toward 'loop' and 'loops'.

L25n1187.name: word-initial g fragments
L25n1187.description: Fires on the 'g' or 'G' that starts a word or name piece ('gilded', 'gloomy', 'Galloway', 'gorges', 'Gospels'), mostly mid-sentence. Pushes toward 'general', 'universal' and 'global'.

L26n1767.name: acronym and name-start letters
L26n1767.description: Fires on the capital letter or short piece that starts an acronym or name ('J' in JAXA, 'E' in EPA, 'Caj' in Cajete, 'et' in 'et al.', '(g' in O2(g)). Pushes toward question marks.

L25n489.name: word-opening prefix pieces
L25n489.description: Fires on the opening piece of a prefix or word split into tokens: 'Con' in 'Conversely', 're' in 'nonreproductive', 'In' starting 'In addition', 'Least' in 'Least Recently Used'. Pushes toward 'result' and 'outcome'.

L26n2297.name: name-opening fragments
L26n2297.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a proper name split into tokens ('Hol' in Holman and Holocene, 'Zam' in Zambezi, 'Sol' in Solon, 'Mor' in Morley, 'Am' in Amish). Pushes toward 'proposed' and 'proposal'.

L25n2237.name: -st and rem fragments
L25n2237.description: Goes strongly negative on the '-st' or 'st' piece of a split or hyphenated word ('stressed', 'stimulating', 'stearic') and on 'rem' in 'remained'. Pushes toward 'remain', 'stay' and 'persist'.

L26n2738.name: descriptive adjectives in prose
L26n2738.description: Diffuse: fires weakly across most news and history prose, strongest on descriptive adjectives before a noun ('abandoned spacecraft', 'ambitious vision', 'spectacular finds', 'vast'). Pushes toward `` and '' quote marks.

L26n392.name: line-break and open-paren boundaries
L26n392.description: Goes strongly negative on a newline, opening parenthesis or dash that splits a phrase mid-sentence ('inspired ⏎by', '(' before '27.2°C', '(' in 'LAMP (Linux'). Pushes toward the prepositions 'of', 'to' and 'by'.

L26n2993.name: short word-start fragments
L26n2993.description: Fires on the start of a word split into tokens, mostly short fragments ('me' in meadow and megalomaniac, 'Man' in Man's Search, 'thr' in thrived, 'der' in deranged). Pushes toward 'brain', 'mind' and 'mental'.

L26n3035.name: Ex opening explain prompts
L26n3035.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'Ex' or 'exp' that opens 'Explain' and 'Examine' in task prompts, and on 'exp' in words like expanding and inexplicably. Pushes toward 'explanation' and 'explain'.

L26n2492.name: year digits in dates
L26n2492.description: Goes strongly negative on the first or second digit of a year in historical text ('1' in 'in 1974', '9' in '1998', '1' in 'Born in 1902'). Pushes toward 'mouth' and 'oral'.

L26n529.name: second word of titles
L26n529.description: Goes strongly negative on the second word of a multi-word title or term ('Stockholders' Meeting', 'Civil War', 'Patient Safety', 'Cultural Organization', 'Project Update'). Pushes toward 'Re' words such as 'Report' and 'Release'.

L26n3070.name: surname and name fragments
L26n3070.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a surname, place name or word split into tokens ('Cast' in Castile, 'McInt' in McIntyre, 'McG' in McGraw, 'pict' in pictogram). Pushes toward 'paint' and 'draw'.

L26n2713.name: word-start fragments before splits
L26n2713.description: Fires on the first piece of a longer word or name split into tokens ('Stra' in Straits, 'emb' in embarks, 'Ber' in Berzelius, 'Cass' in Cassia, 'observ' in observables). Pushes toward single-letter variables 'X' and 'Y'.

L25n768.name: word-initial e and é
L25n768.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'e' or 'E', or accented 'é' or 'É', that starts a word or abbreviation ('e.g.', 'eukaryotes', 'E.coli', 'ecosystems', 'émigré'). Pushes toward 'if' and 'si'.

L26n26.name: hyphen and name-piece fragments
L26n26.description: Goes strongly negative on a fragment right after a hyphen or inside a split name or word ('-W' in Abu l-Walid, '-A' in Abdulaziz, 'Kr' in krill, 'Ro' in Roche, 'SW' in ALLOW). Pushes toward odd word-end pieces such as '-ILITY' and '-ATTLE'.

L26n2025.name: harm and disease words
L26n2025.description: Fires on names of harms, toxins and diseases and on the piece that starts them (radiation, arsenic, chloride, pollution, diarrhea, Zika, rickets, measles). Pushes toward 'pressure', 'stress' and 'force'.

L26n550.name: Split place-name fragments
L26n550.description: The first piece of a capitalized name split across tokens (Có|rdoba, Det|rick, Nil|otes), before the rest of the name; pushes toward a bare 'd'/'da' word ending.

L26n325.name: Word stems before suffix
L26n325.description: The stem piece of a long word split into tokens (attrib|utions, trib|une, def|inate, res|ided), where the suffix is still to come; pushes toward suffix pieces like '-inations' and '-iators'.

L25n2207.name: Non-existence and ex- pieces
L25n2207.description: Negation or absence words (never, non-, out, cease to) and 'ex' word starts (pre|ex|posure, ex|oplanets); pushes toward 'exist' and 'existing', which steered outputs spam.

L26n2301.name: Name-start pieces, cloud output
L26n2301.description: The first piece of a split proper or chemical name (sul|foxaflor, T|endulkar, Ash|kelon, Dor|set, Ker|rie); pushes hard toward 'cloud' tokens, which steered outputs spam.

L26n2566.name: Name pieces, ampersand output
L26n2566.description: Mid-word fragments of names and terms (I|admon, Tar|quin, Ass|ites, Sar|acen, cred|iting) before the word ends; pushes toward '&' tokens, which steered outputs spam.

L25n2750.name: Place-name pieces, missing output
L25n2750.description: Word pieces that open a place or proper name (Marr|akesh, Nord|hausen, Mart|el, Pry|pyat) and '-int' in high- and low-intensity; pushes toward 'missing', which steered outputs repeat.

L26n1446.name: Network and community phrases
L26n1446.description: The word just before the final noun of a technical or institutional name (Telephone| Network, scientific| community, Proof of Cons|ensus, Van| Gogh); pushes toward 'net' tokens.

L26n3038.name: Color words
L26n3038.description: Color words and shades (red, blue, yellow, gray, colour, shade) describing what a thing looks like; pushes toward 'green' tokens, which steered outputs spam.

L26n523.name: Connectives after ML phrases
L26n523.description: Function words inside technical course-description text (for calculating, a data analysis, and tree-based), right before a technical noun; pushes toward 'language', 'syntax', and 'sentence' tokens.

L25n2150.name: Word before month name
L25n2150.description: The word right before a month or season reference (mid-June, the coolest month is, on a hot summer, bright Sunday); pushes toward month names, which steered outputs repeat.

L26n1373.name: Word-piece starts, down output
L26n1373.description: The first piece of a split word or name (Meg|iddo, Gen|oa, Ep|ictetus, Ph|ra), with no single theme; pushes toward 'down' tokens, which steered outputs repeat.

L26n2847.name: Research-paper framing words
L26n2847.description: Academic framing words right before a study's object noun (several significant| gaps, Empirical and| clinical, Research| ), predicting 'method'; pushes toward 'method' tokens, which steered outputs spam.

L26n2900.name: 'ep' word-start pieces
L26n2900.description: The 'ep' or 'p' piece that opens a split word (Ep|iphanes, ep|idermis, ep|inephrine, P|erna), mid-word; pushes toward 'host' tokens, which steered outputs repeat.

L26n1269.name: 'j' starts, studies output
L26n1269.description: The 'j' that opens a split word (j|amb, j|icama, j|acks, j|igsaw) and 'tai' in tai chi; pushes toward 'studies' and 'tests', which steered outputs repeat.

L26n1980.name: Name starts, bus output
L26n1980.description: The first piece of a split name or term (Ne|utrons, Tar|quin, El|ham, V|itiligo, rav|ens); pushes toward 'bus' tokens, which steered outputs repeat.

L25n1475.name: Mid-word technical pieces
L25n1475.description: Mid-word pieces of technical or medical words (pan|leukopenia, ca|uliflower, neu|romas, Astr|onomical, ad|renalin); pushes toward 'data' tokens, which steered outputs repeat.

L26n391.name: -ly adverb stems
L26n391.description: The stem of an '-ly' adverb split across tokens (harmon|iously, satisf|actorily, compreh|ensively, chem|ically), right before the '-ly' ending; pushes toward adverbs like 'completely' and 'deeply'.

L25n2953.name: Assorted word-start pieces
L25n2953.description: Word-start pieces of split words with no single theme (Bo|aters, Bo|is Blanc, rh|izae, Decre|ased, Gleicheni|aceae); pushes toward 'growth' and 'grow' tokens, which steered outputs spam.

L26n59.name: Newline after user turn
L26n59.description: The newline right after the user's <|im_end|> that opens the assistant turn; pushes toward quote marks and ellipses, which steered outputs spam as '...'.

L25n2716.name: Name-piece starts, normal output
L25n2716.description: The first piece of a split proper name (Ju|icy, Ru|shd, Zek|iah, Rams|es, Hor|owitz, Kle|bsiella), before its ending; pushes toward 'normal' and 'ordinary', which steered outputs repeat.

L26n865.name: Mid-word fragment → 'before'
L26n865.description: Fires on a word piece that is split across tokens and needs a continuation, e.g. 'al' in albinism and alums, 'micro' in microbicides, 'tid' in tidal, 'grand' in grandparents, 'isha' in Tisha, 'apost' in apostrophe. Pushes the model toward 'before'/'Before'; when steered it outputs 'before' repeatedly.

L25n132.name: URL/code fragment → hyphen-suffix
L25n132.description: Fires on a word piece inside a URL, filename, code identifier or transliterated word, especially the token just before a dot or hyphen break (e.g. 'ol' in nuts-and-bolts, 'oph' in Pseudophodes, '-doc' in a PDF name, 's' in password.google, 'style' in a URL). Pushes the model toward hyphen-joined suffixes like '-of', '-type', '-object'; when steered it produces hyphenated compounds such as 'nature-owning'.

L26n753.name: Split-word stem pieces
L26n753.description: The first or middle piece of a word split across tokens, just before its completion (medic|ated, acceler|ates, infl|amed, Ber|iberi). Whole words stay near zero. Pushes toward closing punctuation such as ')' and '...'.

L25n2018.name: Biology name fragments
L25n2018.description: Goes negative on the inner piece of biology and taxon words split into tokens (rhiz|ome, rhiz|obia, Cenchr|us, Rhod|odendron, Klebs|iella). Pushing it negative makes the model write 'dimension', 'vector' and 'matrix'.

L26n2489.name: Medical word-stem fragments
L26n2489.description: The stem piece of a medical or body-related word split into tokens (infl|amed, intest|ines, fl|aring, pred|iabetes, av|ascular). Pushes toward 'prepare', 'prepared' and 'ready'.

L25n607.name: Daily and threshold limits
L25n607.description: Goes negative on quantity-limit words in reference-value text, mostly 'daily' in 'recommended daily amount/intake', plus 'threshold', 'absolute', 'small' and 'these'. Pushes toward 'values'.

L26n2867.name: Proper-name starts, negative
L26n2867.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name, place or breed split into tokens (Dor|set, Rip|a d'Arno, Hoj|iblanca, Sk|opje). Pushes toward 'van', 'Van', 'Dutch' and 'Netherlands'.

L25n2582.name: Quality adjectives: good, best
L25n2582.description: Fires on evaluative adjectives after 'a' or 'the' (good fit, best surfing, very popular, better tools, best practice), and on some first name pieces (Yud|hoyono). Pushes toward 'value' and 'economy'.

L26n890.name: Name and drug stems
L26n890.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly names or drug and chemical terms (Zeld|ovich, Leeuwen|hoek, ibu|profen, Car|cassonne, Pro|truding). Pushes toward 'each', 'every' and 'daily'.

L26n2630.name: Dev word stems
L26n2630.description: The stem 'dev' in deviance/deviate and similar split stems, plus names such as Mandeb, Caliph and Veneto. Reads a word stem and pushes toward word-ending suffix pieces such as '-etic', '-ical', '-emia' and '-ems'.

L26n346.name: Stems before -tion nouns
L26n346.description: A verb or noun stem split just before its nominalizing suffix (recogn|ising, attrib|utions, separ|ability, Surre|nder, quant|ification). Pushes toward '-tion' nouns such as definition, description and measurement.

L26n89.name: Big-number quantities
L26n89.description: Fires on the digit of a large number attached to a unit such as billion, million, km, acres, pounds, gallons or mph. Pushes toward nationality and country adjectives (American, Russian, Brazilian).

L25n928.name: Opening paren before acronym
L25n928.description: Goes negative on the '(' that opens an acronym expansion (Federal Emergency Relief Administration (FERA), fatty acid synthase (FAS)) and on 'versus' in 'Fact versus Fiction'. Pushes toward f- and fl- UI and code words such as front, flag, flow and feature.

L25n1335.name: Search and pursuit words
L25n1335.description: Fires on pieces of words and titles about searching or pursuing, usually mid-word (purs|ues, explor|ation, 'Man's Search for Meaning'). The pattern is diffuse. Pushes toward 'seek', 'seeking' and 'search'.

L26n1903.name: Capitalized name starts, news
L26n1903.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name or noun split into tokens (Cit|igroup, Therm|opylae, Hum|mingbird, Przew|alski, McGraw-H|ill). Pushes toward 'news' and 'News'.

L26n1725.name: Illness word starts (fever)
L26n1725.description: Goes negative on the opening piece of an illness or infection word split into tokens (fe|vers, se|psis, Dis|order, Inf|ection). Pushes toward 'follow', 'followed' and 'Follow'.

L25n2548.name: Mid-word fragments, exception
