L25n2548.description: Goes negative on scattered mid-word fragments, often starting with m, mar, com or de (mar|veled, de|odorized, Com|mencing, Gut|macher, Vancom|ycin). Pushes toward 'except', 'unless' and 'until'. No single clear trigger.

L26n975.name: At/of before qualifiers
L26n975.description: Goes negative on function words that open a qualifying phrase: 'at' in at-risk and at least, 'of' in Department of and Secretary of, and 'Sup' in suppressed. Pushes toward 'test' and 'trial'.

L25n1675.name: Place and people starts
L25n1675.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name, place or people split into tokens (Sl|avic, Ad|en, Al|-Andalus, Sid|on, sycam|ore). Pushes toward 'boost', 'increase' and 'enhance'.

L25n3008.name: 3D and axis words
L25n3008.description: Fires on the '3' in '3D' or 'three-dimensional' and on spatial axis words (vertical, horizontal, diagonal, along the diagonal). Strongest on the '3'. Pushes toward 'axis' and 'dimension'.

L26n1315.name: Geo/Gu word starts
L26n1315.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word starting 'ge', 'gu', 'gl' or 'Ge' split into tokens (ge|ology, Gu|atemalan, Ge|obacter, gl|ances). Pushes toward 'communication' and 'communicate'.

L25n2845.name: Group and place starts
L25n2845.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized group, religion or place name split into tokens (Ch|aldeans, B|antus, B|aha'ism, Fil|adelfia, Pal|estine). Pushes toward 'always', 'definitely' and 'guaranteed'.

L26n219.name: 'mental' in wellbeing text
L26n219.description: Fires on 'mental' in 'mental health' and similar wellbeing phrases, weaker on scattered tokens in SQL, citations and lists. Pushes toward short 'ab', 'ac' and 'ap' word-start fragments.

L25n3003.name: CSS/HTML styling terms
L25n3003.description: Fires on CSS and web-styling words mid-phrase: 'CSS', 'font', 'table cell', 'no border', 'canvas' in web-design text. Pushes toward the token 'class' or 'classes'.

L26n1491.name: Word fragments to 'typically'
L26n1491.description: Fires on the first piece of a long or technical word split into tokens (e.g. 'seab' in seabirds, 'lipid', 'Organ' in organochlorine, 'sul' in sulfoxaflor). Pushes toward hedges 'typically', 'usually' and 'generally'.

L26n1088.name: Ohm symbol, Con- starts
L26n1088.description: Fires on the Ω symbol after resistance values ('200 Ω', '22 Ω') and on the first piece of 'Con-' and 'Cont-' words (containment, conc-, conventional). Pushes toward 'act', 'acct' and 'tag' fragments.

L25n1605.name: 'World' and name fragments
L25n1605.description: Fires on 'World' before 'Health Organization' or 'Bank', and on the middle piece of foreign surnames or species names (e.g. 'ort' in Bortnyik, 'cord' in cordata). Pushes toward 'result' and 'results'.

L26n2383.name: Word-start of proper nouns
L26n2383.description: Fires on the short first piece of a capitalized or multi-piece noun right after 'the' or 'a' (e.g. 'Sal' in Salamis, 'Al' in Al Andalus, 'Sl' in slaves, 'fr' in franchised). Pushes toward 'list' and 'lists'.

L25n632.name: 'Con-' starts, hedged 'not'
L25n632.description: Fires on word-start pieces 'Con', 'Cor' and 'And' (conventional, Conception, Andalusia) and on 'not', 'necessarily' and 'always' in hedged negations like 'does not necessarily'. Pushes toward 'parallel' and 'matching'.

L26n1425.name: Stem before '-ist'/'-ian'
L26n1425.description: Fires on the stem just before a person-noun suffix, e.g. 'mathematic' in mathematician, 'theor' in theorist, 'agr-onom' in agronomist, 'hydro-log' in hydrologist. Pushes toward predicting '-ist' or '-ian'.

L26n1243.name: Contracted negative stems
L26n1243.description: Fires on the stem of a contracted negative ('isn', 'doesn', 'aren', 'shouldn') just before the apostrophe-t, and on 'Copyright'. Pushes toward HTML entity starts like '&' and '"'.

L25n1316.name: Mid-word fragments, suffix-pushing
L25n1316.description: Fires on a short middle piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'br' in fe-br-ile, 'fibr' in fibrin, 'hr' in Euphrates, 'al' in albacore. Pushes toward word-ending suffixes 'es', 'ed', 'em' and 'el'.

L26n2578.name: Software/code engineering words
L26n2578.description: Fires on software and code-engineering words mid-sentence: 'code' in code reuse, 'Software' in software development, 'programming' habits, 'write' code. Pushes toward 'maintain' and 'maintenance'.

L25n330.name: Closing quotes, line breaks
L25n330.description: Fires on the closing quote mark plus line break after a quotation in quote lists, and on 'worlds' and 'everywhere' in those lists. Pushes toward hyphen-joined fragments like '-be', '-s' and '-p'.

L26n238.name: Capital letter starting names
L26n238.description: Fires on the first letter or piece of a capitalized name or word split into tokens (e.g. 'G' in Gerais, 'M' in Marrakesh, 'V' in Vitiligo, 'metam' in metamorphosis). Pushes toward closing parentheses, brackets and quote-marks.

L25n2614.name: Input verbs, env quotes
L25n2614.description: Fires on input verbs in coding prompts ('reads', 'takes', 'accepts' in 'a program that reads...') and on the quoted NOPASSWD and echo lines of sudoers setup. Pushes toward 'environment' and 'env'.

L26n511.name: 'into' after came/come/took
L26n511.description: Fires on the particle after 'come', 'came' or 'took' in set phrases ('come into practice', 'came into use', 'took place', 'at risk'). Pushes toward random code and tech tokens, with little visible effect.

L26n2421.name: Long-word first pieces
L26n2421.description: Fires on the first piece of a long word split into tokens (e.g. 'glyc' in glycogen, 'incom' in incomparable, 'decom' in decompose, 'compreh' in comprehensively). Pushes toward 'divide' and 'division'.

L26n2844.name: Place names, first piece
L26n2844.description: Fires on the first piece of place or proper names such as 'Marr' in Marrakesh, 'Zam' in Zambezi, 'Mal' in Malawi, 'ata' in Crataegus. Pushes toward 'independent' and 'dependent'.

L25n2336.name: IT and management systems
L25n2336.description: Fires on the second word of IT and business system names, e.g. 'management' in content management, 'ing' in ticketing system, plus 'software', 'automated' and 'web-based' in software text. Pushes toward 'system'.

L26n1043.name: Finance rate/return terms
L26n1043.description: Fires on finance-rate phrase words: 'internal' in internal rate of return, 'Annual' in Annual Percentage Rate, 'Health' in Health Savings Accounts, plus stray word fragments. Pushes toward 'costs', 'expense' and 'expenditure'.

L25n1714.name: Surname middle piece
L25n1714.description: Fires on a middle piece of a surname or place name split into tokens (e.g. 'K|re|imer', 'Bruns|bü|ttel', 'Hugo G|rot|ius', 'Clem|ence|au'). Pushes toward 'interest' and 'interested'.

L25n660.name: Formal and mathematical derivation
L25n660.description: Fires on the piece of a formal or maths word just before its ending, e.g. 'formally', 'mathematically' (the 'atically' piece), 'clearly', and 'step' in physics and maths prose; pushes toward 'derive' and 'derivation'.

L26n519.name: Acronym-opening parenthesis
L26n519.description: The '(' right after a spelled-out name, just before its abbreviation, e.g. 'Defence (CARD)', 'Institute (CPSI)', 'Kansas City Clubs United (KCCU)'; pushes toward capital-letter acronym tokens like CM, CX, CC.

L26n2615.name: Word-start fragments, writes 'known'
L26n2615.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, usually a consonant-cluster start mid-sentence, e.g. 'shr' (shrub), 'Cr' (Crataegus), 'kr' (krill), 'Cl' (clamato), 'V' (Venezuela); pushes toward 'known' and 'famous'.

L25n2269.name: Cross and X marks
L25n2269.description: Scattered across game and drawing instructions: 'not' after a contrast ('pictures, not numbers'), 'cross' or 'X' marks (cross out, red crosses), and 'point' in 'fine point marker'; pushes toward 'cross' and 'X'.

L25n1985.name: First-person copula
L25n1985.description: The verb right after a subject pronoun in self-description, e.g. 'I [am] writing', 'I'[m] sure', 'We [are] very proud', 'It[']s'; pushes toward the word 'super'.

L25n1537.name: Split name second halves
L25n1537.description: The inner piece of a name or rare word split across tokens, e.g. 'Tong' in Hunga Tonga, 'be' in Zambezi, 'Yog' in yogi, 'pp' in Peppermint; pushes toward 'adult'.

L26n277.name: Title-Case heading words
L26n277.description: A capitalised word inside a Title-Case heading or proper name, e.g. 'Does [It] Take', 'Stratospheric [Polar]', 'Generalized [Bone]'; pushes toward more Title-Case text with no clear meaning.

L26n1629.name: Stem before -er suffix
L26n1629.description: The stem of an agent noun just before its '-er' ending, split into tokens, e.g. 'gard|ener', 'retrie|ver', 'steam|er', 'absor|ber', 'breed|er', 'engr|aver'; pushes toward '-er' suffix pieces such as 'per', 'iter', 'ver'.

L25n2406.name: Health-care provider context
L25n2406.description: The word 'care' in 'health care provider' or 'health care worker', plus the words just before it (frontline, 'consult your health'), in medical and clinical text; pushes toward 'health'.

L26n2283.name: 'Full' in view links
L26n2283.description: The word 'full' in 'view the full story / size / text / image' phrasing, and a few acronym letters; pushes toward 'text' and 'texture'.

L26n90.name: Name fragments, writes adverbs
L26n90.description: Name or word fragments mid-token, e.g. 'aph' in Sapphari, 'rev' in Trevor, 'Dyn' in the Dyn attack, 'oh' in Almohad; pushes toward sentence adverbs such as 'actually', 'furthermore', 'luckily'.

L26n275.name: Bracketed template placeholders
L26n275.description: The word inside a bracketed placeholder slot in templates, e.g. 'Dear [Name]', '[Project Name]', '[Client Name]', plus file-extension and URL tokens such as '.csv' and '://'; pushes toward closing code punctuation.

L25n2256.name: Finance and loan terms
L25n2256.description: The word just before a key finance noun in loan, option and banking text, e.g. 'alternative lenders', 'options contract', 'bank liquidity'; pushes toward 'investment'.

L26n2062.name: Stem before -on suffix
L26n2062.description: The stem right before an '-on' or '-ons' ending that is split into tokens, e.g. 'reck|ons', 'Maim|onides', 'Astr|onauts', 'Parthen|on', 'so|ons'; pushes toward '-on' endings such as 'ons', 'ones', 'oned'.

L25n3009.name: Tech spec modifiers
L25n3009.description: The number or modifier inside technical hardware and science names, e.g. '7' in '7-inch display', '4' in '4x4 keypad', 'Color' in 'Ocean Color Imager', 'Daw' in 'Dawes Gap'; pushes toward 'channel'.

L26n415.name: Holy and Broad names
L26n415.description: The word before the end of a multi-word name, mainly 'Holy' (Holy Bible, Holy Prophet, Holy See), 'Broad' (Broad Breasted), and 'de', 'del', 'la' in Spanish place names; pushes toward the letter 'l'.

L26n1380.name: Indefinite 'a' before noun
L26n1380.description: The indefinite 'a' in 'have a wide selection', 'supported by a resource pack', 'created a Spotify', and similar slots before a list noun; pushes toward 'range'.

L26n1147.name: Compound-word first halves
L26n1147.description: The first piece of a split compound word, right before its second half, e.g. 'dough|nut', 'dust| jacket', 'sand|lot', 'Con|versely', 'visually| impaired'; pushes toward the letter 'j' as noise.

L25n2784.name: Machine-learning context words
L25n2784.description: Words in machine-learning and data-science text just before a key technical term, e.g. 'as well as' before SVM, 'neural networks and' before tree-based methods, 'deep' before learning; pushes toward 'feature' and 'features'.

L26n1724.name: Acronym parenthesis, M-words
L26n1724.description: The '(' or first letter right before an acronym abbreviation, e.g. '(MET)', '(MIF)', '(HMOs)', '(MDA)', '(WMO)', '(ECMWF)'; pushes toward M-initial words such as 'message', 'money', 'match'.

L25n422.name: Punctuation inside compound terms
L25n422.description: Fires on a hyphen, period, underscore or open parenthesis inside a compound, URL, number or formula ('omega-3', 'Covid-19', 'owl.english', 'SiO_2', '(' opening an aside); pushes toward 'by', 'more' and repetitive filler.

L26n1344.name: Mid-word 'R'/'re' fragments
L26n1344.description: Strongly negative on a word-internal piece that starts a longer name or word, most often 'R' or 're' ('Rolls-Royce', 'non-reproductive', 'somatostatin', 'Uppsala', 'Rabbinate'); pushes toward 'res' tokens.

L26n2640.name: Split-word first piece
L26n2640.description: Strongly negative on the first sub-word piece of a word cut across tokens, often a short consonant start ('cr' in crickets, 'Hor' in Horowitz, 'di' in diocese, '-W' in Writers); pushes toward 'r' and 'rea' fragments.

L25n909.name: Word fragment to 'thanks'
L25n909.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment or name piece, often the start of a split word ('thr' in 'thrifty', 'pl', 'sou', 'gl', 'ath' in Radbod); pushes toward 'thanks', 'thank' and 'respect'.

L26n2655.name: Latin and name fragments
L26n2655.description: Strongly negative on the opening fragment of a Latin, plant or proper name split across tokens ('Cr' in Crataegus, 'Para' in Pará, 'Mon' in monounsaturated, 'cre' in crevice spider); pushes toward 'out' tokens.

L26n1959.name: Gender and sexuality words
L26n1959.description: Strongly negative on 'gender', 'sexual(ly)', 'sex' and word-start pieces like 'rec', 'demon', 'idol' inside text on gender, sexuality, victims or identity; pushes toward 'object', 'ivation' and '-ify'.

L25n1025.name: Word-start fragments, '!' output
L25n1025.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, often capitalized or a name start ('Hon' in Honshu, 'kr' in krill, 'Un' in Unconsoled, 'Ar' in arthritis); pushes toward '!' and exclamation marks.

L25n1438.name: Auxiliary before main verb
L25n1438.description: Strongly negative on a modal or perfect auxiliary ('has', 'had', 'have', 'can', 'could', 'may') directly before its main verb, as in 'has so far not', 'had not been', 'could create'; pushes toward 'prove' and 'proved'.

L26n704.name: Technical word fragments, 'incident'
L26n704.description: Strongly negative on a mid-word piece of a longer technical word ('om' in hypomethylation, 'j' in jicama, 'ob' in retinoblastoma, 'inse' in inseparable); pushes toward 'incident', 'occurrence', 'phenomenon'.

L25n2875.name: 'Public' and 'public domain'
L25n2875.description: Fires on the word 'public' or 'Public' (and 'publicly', 'Pub'), as in 'public good', 'Public Law', 'public spaces'; pushes toward 'domain' and 'domains'.

L26n57.name: Sustainability copy, digit output
L26n57.description: Strongly negative on mixed tokens, mostly 'be' after 'might not', 'from' after 'made', 'non' in 'non-toxic', 'Call' in 'Call 911', and eco or sustainability words; pushes toward digit tokens and number lists.

L26n1210.name: 'ep'/'micro' word openers
L26n1210.description: Strongly negative on a short prefix token that opens a longer word, most often 'ep' (epinephrine, epigenetic, epiphany) and 'micro' (microbicide, microstructure); pushes toward 'at' and 'ats' fragments.

L25n1982.name: Words before arithmetic operations
L25n1982.description: Strongly negative on the word that sets up a computation, e.g. 'binary' in 'binary addition', 'performs', 'implements', and 'to' or 'for' before 'calculate' or 'algorithm'; pushes toward 'addition', 'add' and 'subtract'.

L25n1171.name: Opening quote before term
L25n1171.description: Strongly negative on an opening quote, parenthesis or colon that introduces a term or list ('the “green revolution”', 'known as “', 'valid identifiers are:'), plus 'revolution' itself; pushes toward '_' underscores.

L26n322.name: Hedging and degree modifiers
L26n322.description: Fires on degree or manner modifiers before an adjective or verb ('a little daunting', 'slightly darker', 'gently patted', 'barely', 'pretty'), and on a few list-joining words; pushes toward garbled non-English tokens like 'xAA' and 'ogóle'.

L26n386.name: Chat-turn boundary newline
L26n386.description: Strongly negative on the newline that follows a user's '<|im_end|>' and comes just before '<|im_start|>assistant', i.e. where a chat reply starts; pushes toward odd fragments like '_da' and 'ady'.

L25n1095.name: Split proper-name openers
L25n1095.description: Strongly negative on the opening piece of a proper noun or uncommon word split across tokens ('Sam' in Samoans, 'Char' in Charon, 'Daw' in Dawes, 'M' in Mennonite, 'tm' in Gutenberg-style names); pushes toward 'measure' tokens.

L26n1944.name: Region and direction qualifiers
L26n1944.description: Strongly negative on a geographic or climate qualifier before a place or climate noun ('Middle' East, 'southern' Palestine, 'northeast', 'Atlantic' coast, 'tropical' savanna, 'subtropical' highland); pushes toward 'park' tokens.

L25n1627.name: Travel booking words
L25n1627.description: Strongly negative on booking and travel-service words, mainly 'book', 'hotel', 'flight', 'ticket', 'seat', 'lodging' and 'plane', in trip planning or reservation text; pushes toward 'book' and 'Book'.

L25n1931.name: 'come' and 'https' tokens
L25n1931.description: Fires on 'come' in phrases like 'come to', 'come out' and 'come from', on 'https' after 'curl' or 'from', and on name fragments like 'udd'; pushes toward 'close' and 'convergence'.

L25n525.name: Diffuse; writes 'program'
L25n525.description: Fires weakly and diffusely in web prose on words that set up an expected next word, like 'going' before 'to grow' or 'had' in 'has had a significant'; pushes toward 'program', 'project', 'device' and 'system' nouns, and at high dose loops on 'program'.

L26n272.name: Agency and payment names
L26n272.description: Goes strongly negative on the word inside an institution or agency name, like 'Environmental' in 'U.S. Environmental Protection Agency' and 'of' in 'State Board of', and on regulatory or utility nouns like racial, municipal and wastewater; pushes toward 'Payment', 'Authority', 'Parties' and 'authentication'.

L25n1782.name: Earth-science terms (rock, soil)
L25n1782.description: Goes negative on geoscience and land-use nouns, like 'soil' in 'soil quality', 'rock' in 'rock mass', 'sediment' in 'sedimentary layers', and 'forest' or 'land cover' in ecology text; pushes toward 'property' and 'properties'.

L26n2127.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'family'
L26n2127.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, like 'il' in 'Vit-il-igo', 'f' before 'amily', or 'Rab' in a surname; pushes toward 'family' and 'families', and at high dose the model spams 'family'.

L26n2730.name: Word-start 'res' piece
L26n2730.description: Fires on a 'res' piece opening a word split into tokens, like 'Res' in Resiliency and 'res' in resettle or resistance, with milder firing on 'cyber' and 'climate' in security and climate-resilience text; pushes toward more 'res' tokens such as res and resolute.

L25n2128.name: Health-system nouns → 'access'
L25n2128.description: Fires on 'health', 'healthcare' and 'Medicare' in health-system or insurance text, like 'healthcare' in 'healthcare system' or 'Health Insurance Marketplace', and pushes toward 'access'.

L26n116.name: Name fragments → 'transition'
L26n116.description: Goes negative on a middle piece of a proper name split into tokens, like 'mat' in 'bas-mati', 'Taj' in 'Taj Mahal', 'akes' in Marrakesh and 'Nay' in Nayak; pushes toward 'transition', 'transform' and 'initialize'.

L26n2363.name: Word fragment → 'sentence'
L26n2363.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of split words, like 'ole' in 'Elaeis oleifera' and oleic, 'shr' in shrubs, 'scal' in scallops and 'ol' in scoliosis; pushes toward 'sentence' and 'paragraph'.

L26n1312.name: 'cl'/'dis' onset → 'content'
L26n1312.description: Fires on word-opening fragments like 'Cl' in 'Climb', 'cl' in clumps and clench, and 'dis' in 'disservice' and 'discipline'; pushes toward 'content' and 'contents'.

L25n2020.name: Quantity nouns before 'of'
L25n2020.description: Goes strongly negative on a quantity or measure noun right before 'of', like 'age' in 'at the age of', 'number' in 'a number of', 'thousands' of years or 'kinds' of; pushes toward 'of' and 'off', and at high dose loops on 'of'.

L25n1482.name: Graph and curve nouns
L25n1482.description: Fires on the word that names a plot or diagram, like 'graphs' after 'curves are', 'curve' in candlepower curve, 'profile' and 'diagram', and on function-name pieces in graphing problems like 'angent' in cotangent; pushes toward 'graph'.

L26n904.name: Name-start fragments, bare 'n'
L26n904.description: Goes negative on the start of a multi-letter name or abbreviation split into tokens, like 'Man' in Manitoba, 'San' in San Francisco, 'Min' in Minn., and the 'N' in [D-NY]; pushes toward a bare 'n' or 'N'.

L26n2067.name: Onset fragment → 'bond'
L26n2067.description: Goes negative on the consonant-cluster start of a word split into tokens, like 'squ' in squirts and squander, 'sw' in swamps, 'str' in stricken and 'gu' in guerilla; pushes toward 'bond', 'married' and 'marriage'.

L25n1402.name: Google brand names
L25n1402.description: Fires on the brand word 'Google' and on 'Maps' in product names, like 'Google Maps', 'Google Tag Manager' and 'Google VR'; pushes toward 'JSON' and 'API', though the steered effect is weak.

L26n2827.name: Word fragment → 'w'
L26n2827.description: Goes negative on a middle piece of a split word, like 'eth' in hypomethylation, 'om' in trihalomethane and 'Ele' in elephants; pushes toward a bare 'w' or 'W', and at high dose the model writes 'Ww w w'.

L26n2980.name: Name fragment → 'sample'
L26n2980.description: Fires on capital-letter or name fragments inside split words, like 'Rec' in recombination, 'B' in Bortnyik, 'Com' in Companions and 'C' in cystic; pushes toward 'sample' and 'samples'.

L26n303.name: Place-name fragments, negative
L26n303.description: Goes negative on mid-word pieces of place or person names split into tokens, like 'aw' in Manahawkin, 'Brid' in Bridgeton, 'sh' in Honshu and 'Rock' in Rockwall; pushes toward 'ancestor', 'inheritance' and 'reference'.

L26n2213.name: Tense/interest terms, 'simple'
L26n2213.description: Goes negative on 'Present' and 'Past' in tense lists and on 'paying', 'annual' and 'compounded' in interest problems; pushes toward 'simple', as in Simple Present and simple interest.

L26n230.name: Closing quote/paren; <think>
L26n230.description: Goes negative on closing punctuation after a quote or parenthesis, such as a period then close-paren or a question mark then close-paren, and most strongly on the <think> token that opens a chat-template assistant reply; pushes toward closing tokens like close-quote-bracket and ?).

L25n763.name: Mid-word fragment → 'List'
L25n763.description: Fires on mid-word pieces inside split words and names, like 'if' in kiwifruit, 'Laf' in Lafitte, 'une' in immune and '-H' in self-harming; pushes toward 'List' and 'list'.

L26n1634.name: Letter v word fragments
L26n1634.description: Fires on a 'v' or 'V' that starts a word piece: 'V' in Vitamin, 'v' in antiretroviral, plus weaker hits on mid-word pieces like 'tro', 'oc', 'cor' in medical and nutrition text. Pushes the model toward v-initial tokens (vittoria, villa, violet).

L25n1591.name: Split proper-noun first pieces
L25n1591.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a split proper name, strongest on 'Mah' in Taj Mahal, also 'Yog' in Yogi, 'Mad' in Madison and Madagascar, 'Mat' and 'Mart'. Pushes toward 'enjoy' and 'benefit' forms, which the reading does not share.

L25n1526.name: Word before importance adjective
L25n1526.description: Fires on the word just before an expected 'important' or 'significant' adjective: 'it' in 'why is it important', 'is' in 'is significant', 'more' in 'even more important', plus 'particularly' and 'historically'. Pushes toward 'sign' and 'significant'.

L26n1480.name: Treaty and signing words
L26n1480.description: Fires on treaty or signing vocabulary and on the word after it: 'Treaty', 'Agreement', 'Pact', 'Convention', 'signed', plus 'was' in 'was signed' and 'to' in 'agreed to' or 'refused to ratify'. Pushes toward 'sign' word forms.

L26n1694.name: Modal should and that
L26n1694.description: Fires on 'should' and 'that' that open a requirement in creative-writing prompts ('The song should', 'a play that'), and on item or subject nouns like 'tee', 'cuisine', 'bracelet', 'monument'. Pushes toward 'feature' and 'features'.

L25n365.name: Split name opening fragment
L25n365.description: Fires on a short fragment that opens a split proper or foreign name, e.g. 'ṛ' in Hṛdaya, 'Gr' in Graceland, 'Har' in Harbor, 'Moh' in Mohenjo; also 'Read' in 'Read More' link text. Pushes toward possessives 'their', 'its', 'themselves'.

L26n844.name: Word completing named title
L26n844.description: Fires on the word that completes a named title or term, often inside quotes: 'Lady' in Iron Lady, 'Boy' in Little Boy, 'Meaning' in Man's Search for Meaning, '-otherapy' in logotherapy. Pushes toward closing quotes and punctuation after a string.

L25n2284.name: Modal before main verb
L25n2284.description: Fires on a modal or auxiliary just before the main verb: 'you'll' in 'you'll be paying', 'will' in 'will stay', 'might' in 'might not solve', 'could', 'don't' before 'damage', and 'we' before 'have'. Pushes toward 'end' and 'ends' forms.

L25n2478.name: School and grade-level terms
L25n2478.description: Fires on education words, mostly 'school' in 'high school' and 'college', plus 'XII' and grade labels, and on the word right after them ('in' in 'majoring in', commas in academic lists). Pushes toward school subjects such as 'history'.

L26n2694.name: Stem before a suffix
L26n2694.description: Fires on a word stem split across tokens right before its suffix: 'System' in Dassault Systèmes, 'cytok' in cytokines, 'techn' in technic, 'partic' before particulates, 'barg' before bargees. Pushes toward plural and suffix tokens 'es', 'e', 'res', 'nes'.

L25n2432.name: Turn verbs, state change
L25n2432.description: Fires on 'turn', 'turned' or 'turning' describing a colour or state change ('leaves have turned yellow', 'skin turning white'), and on the word before it ('have', 'to' in 'appears to be losing'). Pushes toward 'turn' word forms.

L26n1378.name: Split-name middle pieces
L26n1378.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split name, mostly Arabic, Hebrew or Sanskrit names: 'aim' in Maimonides, 'Mah' in Mahal, 'Cord' in Cordoba, 'Acc' in Macclesfield, 'um' in Hanumadhh. Steered output is unrelated (sticks, a pine tree), so the push is unclear.

L26n814.name: Latin-term middle fragments
L26n814.description: Fires on a middle fragment of a split Latin or scientific term: 'am' in Cinnamomum, 'ag' in Selaginellaceae, 'yle' in Xyleborus, 'OC' in Echinococcus, 'ov' in ovary, 'Pret' in Pretoria. Steering pushes toward closing code brackets like ']):' and '}]', not the text.

L26n608.name: Article before key noun
L26n608.description: Fires on a word fragment or article right before the key noun or split word: 'a' before botnet or collision, 'an' before event, 'read' in read(), 'Therm' in Thermopylae, 'der' in deranged, 'spl' in splenium. Pushes toward 'condition' words.

L26n1158.name: Split names, animal words
L26n1158.description: Fires on a piece of a split or capitalised name ('th' in hawthorn, 'WH' in WHSmith, 'National' in agency names) and on animal words like walruses, lion, dog bites. Pushes toward 'pet', 'animal', 'dog' and 'cat'.

L26n3009.name: Disease and virus names
L26n3009.description: Fires on the disease or virus name inside medical text: 'HIV' in HIV-positive or HIV-negative, 'Corona' and '19' in COVID-19, 'Zika', 'rabies', 'CF', 'BRCA', and 'test' before 'positive'. Pushes toward 'positive' and 'negative'.

L25n2557.name: URL scheme http
L25n2557.description: Fires on 'http' or 'https' that opens a web address, most strongly on the colon right after 'http' and on 'https' before '://'. Pushes toward '//' so steered text degenerates into slashes.

L26n2941.name: Se fragment of sepsis
L26n2941.description: Fires on the 'se' opening fragment of sepsis, septic, seborrhea and similar split words, plus 'of', 'with', 'and' in lists of fluids or measurements. Pushes toward 'body' tokens, which the reading does not share.

L25n2783.name: Mid-word g fragments
L25n2783.description: Fires on a short mid-word fragment such as 'g', 'eg', 'ag', 'rec' inside a split word or name: 'eg' in lifeguards, 'g' in Crataegus, 'ig' in Frigidaire, 'leng' in legendary, 'rec' in recitation. Pushes toward closing brackets like ']))' with no link to the text.

L25n2135.name: Construction and building materials
L25n2135.description: Fires on function words and fragments inside construction, DIY and building-material text: 'of' in 'up to 20% of the cement', 'and' in 'lumber and', 'local' in 'local building permits', plus 'cement', 'DIY', 'recycled', 'Metal'. Pushes toward 'construction' and 'building'.

L26n393.name: Contraction and split-word stems
L26n393.description: Fires on the stem before a split-off suffix: 'don' in don't, 'didn', 'shouldn', 'let' in let's, and the first piece of split words such as 'Te' in teach-back and 'del' in delves. Pushes toward opening and closing quotation marks.

L26n1161.name: Capital word-start fragments
L26n1161.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, most often a capital letter that starts a name or acronym: 'V' in Vortex, V2 and Vidalia, 'W' in Wozniak, 'Del' in Delafield, 'Rev' in Revolucionario. Pushes toward 'higher', 'greater' and 'increase'.

L25n1717.name: Time-span words, 'years'
L25n1717.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before a time span or age unit, such as 'first' in first trimester, 'bearing' in child-bearing age and 'one' in one-sixth in a decade, and on 'Har' in place names like Harpenden. Pushes toward 'years'.

L26n2629.name: Word-start fragments, multi-piece words
L26n2629.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a longer word split into tokens: 'igr' in centigrade, 'Pat' in Patagonia, 'Det' in detoxifying, 'opot' in hippopotamus, 'tum' in tummy. Pushes toward 'background'.

L26n2739.name: Sound and hearing words
L26n2739.description: Goes strongly negative on sound- and hearing-related words: 'T' in tinnitus, 'will' in an alarm will sound, 'music' in a song, 'clapping', 'microphone', 'noises', 'buzz or ring'. Pushes toward 'play' and 'playing'.

L26n2948.name: Mid-word fragment before -er
L26n2948.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long word split into tokens, mostly -metre, -rium and -ers words: 'omet' in endometrium, 'imet' in centimetres, 'ilit' in millilitres, 'OST' in FOSTER. Pushes toward word-ending 'er', 'era' and 'mer'.

L26n2193.name: Computer hardware and software
L26n2193.description: Goes strongly negative on computer hardware, software and tech nouns: 'GPU', 'network card', 'graphics processing unit', 'VPN', 'USB', 'Android', 'controller', 'Arduino'. Pushes toward 'driver' and 'drivers'.

L26n1119.name: ALL-CAPS word fragments
L26n1119.description: Goes strongly negative on uppercase letter pieces inside words typed in all capitals: 'IND' in INDENTITY, 'CRE' in CREATOR, 'QUAL' in QUALITY, 'OURSE' in COURSE. Pushes toward uppercase word endings such as 'ORY', 'ERS' and 'ISION'.

L26n653.name: Name starts, CJK glyphs
L26n653.description: Goes strongly negative on the first letter or glyph of a proper name or an unusual token: 'P' in Pheasant Wood, 'Hy' in Hyde Avenue, 勇 in the brave sigil, and 分 and 装 in Japanese and Chinese text. Pushes toward accented-letter fragments such as Ä and â, with no clear theme.

L25n1240.name: Split-word completion pieces
L25n1240.description: Fires on the piece that completes a split word or name mid-word: 'ario' in Revolucionario, 'Hor' in Horizonte, 'ma' in Dalmau, 'vit' in brevitomentosus. Also fires on 'need' after 'will'. Pushes toward 'to', 'à' and 'au'.

L26n1170.name: Compound-word first halves
L26n1170.description: Goes strongly negative on the first half of a compound or phrasal word split across tokens: 'Along' in alongside, 'Break' in breakthrough, 'Under' in underlying, 'Air' in airspace. Pushes toward compound second halves 'out', 'room', 'place', 'ground' and 'point'.

L25n2771.name: Acronym and name fragments
L25n2771.description: Fires on a piece inside an acronym or name that is split into tokens: 'isk' in Oriskany, 'mik' in microC, 'PO' in POC, 'GC' in GCSE, 'Ap' in Apocrypha, 'Mir' in Mirai. Pushes toward 'key' and 'keys'.

L25n1332.name: Verb-adjacent advice word
L25n1332.description: Fires on the word right after a verb or modal in how-to advice: 'more' in turn the pile more frequently, 'ensure' after 'Leaders must', 'put' after 'will', 'routine' after 'changing your'. Pushes toward 'constant' and 'continuous'.

L25n2765.name: Collocation before paper/slate
L25n2765.description: Fires on a word inside a fixed phrase just before its usual object or surface: 'and' in pen and paper, 'blank' in blank slate, 'on' in stored on a substrate. Pushes toward 'paper' and 'card'.

L26n483.name: Mid-word Latin-root fragments
L26n483.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle piece of a long word split into tokens, often Latin or medical: 'ech' in petechiae, 'ch' in parenchyma, 'ros' in Ambrosia, 'th' in hawthorn, 'ocom' in nosocomial. Pushes toward French-style endings 'ieu', 'ieux' and 'iae'.

L26n451.name: Motor and blower terms
L26n451.description: Goes strongly negative on words naming motor, blower or electrical equipment and its properties: 'ower' in blower, 'variable' in variable frequency drives, 'high' in high torque, 'starting' in starting voltage. Pushes toward 'electric', 'energy' and 'gas'.

L26n725.name: Word fragments, spaces dropped
L26n725.description: Fires on the start or middle piece of a long word or name split into tokens: 'Comp' in complications, 'Comm' in commission, 'esp' in lifespans, 'Mag' in Magritte. At +0.5 it pushes toward single capitals and words run together without spaces.

L25n2235.name: Login and user-account words
L25n2235.description: Goes strongly negative on user-account words: 'users', 'user', 'login', 'logged', 'register', and 'Staying' in stay logged in, plus 'trouble' in support dialogue. Pushes toward 'log' and 'sign' (log in, sign in).

L26n70.name: Person-name initials
L26n70.description: Goes strongly negative on the first letter or initial of a person's name, mostly middle initials ('J' in Charles J. Shields, 'J' in Rafid J. Hussein) and name starts ('An' in Anne McKinnell, 'An' in Anja Spang). Pushes weakly toward code tokens like '@return' and 'getPost'.

L25n2687.name: Digits in numeric amounts
L25n2687.description: Goes strongly negative on a digit inside a number quantity, usually the first or second digit of a money amount or count: '4' in Rs 4 billion, '0' in 60 million, '6' in $2.6 million, '4' in 1.4 billion. Pushes toward 'cr' and 'cro'.

L26n2449.name: Mid-name proper-noun fragments
L26n2449.description: The second or later piece of a split proper noun or brand, at the token just before it completes (Alka|-S|eltzer, Christian| Science, Guim|arães, Zu|lu, Mennon|ites). Logit lens writes Spanish -ado/-ido endings, but steering shows little visible effect.

L26n2491.name: Mid-word fragments
L26n2491.description: A piece in the middle of a longer word or name, at the token just before its end (Cór|doba, lot|teries, autom|ating, chron|icle, Ub|ünden, Almo|had). Writes 'data' and 'Data' tokens; when pushed, the output fills with 'data'.

L25n477.name: Acronym and unit endings
L25n477.description: Negative on the last letter or digit of an acronym, unit, or chemical formula in technical text (CH|D, MT|BE, HDHP|s, 107°|C, mm, IGF-|1, SiO2). Pushes toward closing code tokens such as '})' and '},'; the steered effect is weak.

L26n2.name: Answer-start and number tokens
L26n2.description: Fires on the first token of a numeric or list answer: the space before a date or price ('<< >>3640 BCE', '<< >>300°F'), the word after '1.' (The Taj Mahal), and 'got' or 'through' in a narrative. Writes 'Not', 'Given', 'Create' and 'go'; pushed, it repeats 'go'.

L26n2023.name: Record and journal nouns
L26n2023.description: Negative on the word for a recorded or written log in writing-task prompts: 'diary', 'journal', 'blog' (weblogs), 'vlogger', 'progress report', 'gratitude reminder'. Pushes toward the token 'log' and its forms (log, Log, _log).

L26n1204.name: Verb-stem before -ed
L26n1204.description: Negative on the stem or prefix piece of a past-participle verb or adjective split across tokens, right before its -ed or -ated ending (t|amed, re|seeded, dev|iated, v|accinated, app|alled, res|ettled). Pushes toward 'connected', 'linked' and 'shared'.

L25n2882.name: Triangle and side words
L25n2882.description: Fires on the word just before a geometry noun in triangle and area problems: 'of' before 'sides', '=' before a formula, 'right' before 'triangle', 'known' before side lengths, plus the 'Kn' of Knidos. Pushes toward 'side', 'sides' and 'edge'.

L25n1429.name: Negation prefix (un-, ir-)
L25n1429.description: Negative on the negating prefix of a 'not X' word, before the rest of the word (ir|ritable, uns|atisfied, un|profitable, un|viable, ins|urmountable). Pushes toward positive words: 'positive', 'healthy', 'peaceful' and 'peace'.

L26n2771.name: Word-start Im/som fragments
L26n2771.description: Fires on the first piece of a long word split into tokens, when that piece is 'Im', 'som', 'imm' or 'mam' (Immaculate, somatostatin, immemorial, Imager, Molting). Writes a bare 'm' token; pushed, it stuffs 'm' into words.

L25n2781.name: Safety and safe words
L25n2781.description: Negative on the word just before 'safety' or 'safe' in safety text: 'cyber-' (cyber-safety), 'Food and Drug' (Administration), 'safe' split as s|afe, 'valuables', 'Patient' or 'Transport' in safety contexts. Pushes toward 'safety', 'safe' and 'safely'.

L25n2893.name: Hardware component names
L25n2893.description: Negative on the word for a computer or electronics hardware part: 'graphics' (before processing unit), 'network' (card), 'GPU', 'video', 'Arduino' and 'controller', 'Wi-Fi', 'Pi'. Pushes toward 'card' and 'cards'; steered output fills with 'card'.

L26n1579.name: Name-middle letters
L26n1579.description: Fires on a short piece inside a proper noun or technical term, usually the letter or syllable right after the first piece (Stir|r|ers, Isa|a|h, Aeth|i|opia, Buddh|ists, Pad|u|cah, Cabr|era). Writes garbled 'f' and 'fh' tokens; pushed, output turns to 'fhirth' noise.

L26n1750.name: Word-start sp fragments
L26n1750.description: Fires on word-start pieces 'sp', 'Sp', 'Sc', 'sw' and 'Sl' that begin a new word split across tokens (sp|icules, sp|ires, sp|illing, sw|athed, Sc|ads, Schenck|ensch). Writes '*' and '*/' comment tokens; pushed, it writes markdown asterisks around words.

L25n2809.name: Keypad and key input
L25n2809.description: Negative on the word for a physical input part or a finger-press action: 'key' (key clicks), 'keypad' (4x4 keypad), 'keyboards', 'press', 'fret', 'neck', 'finger', 'piano' in device or instrument text. Pushes toward 'key' and 'keys'.

L26n396.name: Ar/Har word starts
L26n396.description: Negative on the first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly 'Ar', 'Har', 'Hos', 'Ste', 'gar', 'Se' (Arabs, harvest, Hosfeld, Stepping, garages). Pushes toward code and comment syntax: '#', '#if', '}' and '*/}'.

L25n879.name: Concern words before raise
L25n879.description: Fires on the word just before 'raise' is expected: 'concerns', 'questions', 'controversy', and 'also' or 'they' inside question phrases ('What concerns does this attack raise?'). Pushes toward 'raise', 'raised' and 'raising'.

L26n2008.name: Split proper-noun starts
L26n2008.description: Negative on the first piece of a split proper noun or long word (Mes|opotamia, Bad|lands, Fol|io, Kub|ayi, Tr|ivium, Vic|ente, Bantus). Writes 'weather', 'rain', 'climate' and 'meteor'; pushed, output repeats 'weather'.

L25n1595.name: Software category before solution
L25n1595.description: Negative on the noun naming a business software category, just before 'solution' or 'platform': 'media asset management', 'content management', 'call center software', 'cloud storage', 'IT', 'analytics', 'procurement'. Pushes toward 'solution' and 'solutions'.

L25n207.name: Answer-start newlines
L25n207.description: Fires on the newline right after '</think>' that opens a chat answer, and on the line break before a list (':⏎- It'). Writes commas and separators ('，', '、', '—'); pushed, the output adds blank lines and '**end**'.

L26n2565.name: Medical condition terms
L26n2565.description: Negative on the first piece of a disease, disorder or health term (immun|odeficiency, hearing loss, arr|hythmia, Psycho, ASD, Inf, irre|parable). Writes 'path' and its forms, the pathology root; steering adds little visible change.

L26n974.name: Split-word start, suffix writer
L26n974.description: Fires on the first piece of a rare word split into tokens, where the word is still unfinished (e.g. 'Sw' in Swallow, 'gl' in glaze, 'Gran' in Granodiorite, 'sn' in snail). Pushed negative, it promotes word-ending pieces like 'cycle' and 'ouch'.

L25n1264.name: Writes 'almost/nearly'
L25n1264.description: Fires on scattered tokens with no single reading: hyphen-split name pieces (get-pip, Nauvoo), 'at' in 'at the same time'. Pushed negative, it promotes 'almost/nearly/roughly' and spams 'almost'.

L26n1755.name: Odd/symmetric writer
L26n1755.description: Fires on the first piece of words starting 'ob', 'und', 'ab' or 'Mend' split into tokens (Observe, Undoubtedly, abacus, Obadiah). Pushed negative, it promotes 'odd', 'symmetric' and spams 'odd'.

L25n1833.name: Games/sports -> 'win'
L25n1833.description: Fires on play, sport and game words (e.g. 'touch' in rugby rules, 'plays' the guitar, 'playing' tennis, 'tabletop', 'single-player'). Pushed negative, it promotes 'win/wins/winning' and turns the story toward racing.

L26n1799.name: Technical fragments -> 'procedure'
L26n1799.description: Fires on the start or middle piece of technical words split into tokens (e.g. 'Im' in Imager, 'atom' in hematoma, 'microscopy', 'welding', 'MRI', 'diagn'). Pushed positive, it promotes 'procedure(s)' and spams it.

L25n138.name: Titles before names
L25n138.description: Fires on honorifics and name-leading tokens, peaking on the period after 'Dr' (Dr. Shaheen, Dr. Anastos) and on 'Professor', 'Mrs', 'President'. Pushed positive, it promotes uppercase codes like 'FI', 'BE', 'IRLD' and spams them.

L25n2105.name: 'ph' fragments -> 'simple'
L25n2105.description: Fires on 'ph' or 'Ph' opening a word piece or name (Phra-, phagocytes, Phos-, phases, 'aph' in aphasia-like words), and on 'ih' in hydrogen. Pushed positive, it promotes 'simple/basic' and spams 'simple'.

L26n185.name: Mid-word piece, foreign suffix
L26n185.description: Fires on a piece in the middle of a name or word (e.g. 'utz' in Gutzon, 'opt' in optician, 'phot' in photovoltaic, 'Moz' in Mozambique, 'stabil' in stabilizer). Pushed negative, it promotes foreign-looking word endings like 'ificados' and 'ulado', with little visible steering effect.

L25n2988.name: Word-initial T/L -> 'cost'
L25n2988.description: Fires on a word's first letter 'T' or 'L' (or lowercase 't' or '-l') when the word is split, e.g. 'T' in Tacos, Tens, Taste, 'L' in Lotto, Lilies. Pushed negative, it promotes 'cost/costs' and spams 'cost'.

L25n1022.name: 'sur' starts -> 'sample'
L25n1022.description: Fires on the start of 'sur' words (surge, survey, surge protector) and on networking words 'Transmit', 'Receive' and 'pull' (pull-down). Pushed negative, it promotes 'sample/samples' and spams 'sample'.

L26n648.name: Chat turn marker, ':'
L26n648.description: Fires on the '<|im_start|>' token that opens a user or assistant turn in the chat template. Pushed negative, it promotes colon and closing-bracket tokens like '):' and ']:' with little visible effect.

L25n238.name: Semicolon writer
L25n238.description: Fires on a capital or lowercase 'K/k' opening a word or name ('K' in Kitten, 'k' in kami, '-K' in Karelian) and on digits in years or figures ('7' in 787, '9' in 1973). Pushed positive, it promotes ';' and spams semicolons.

L25n637.name: Name syllables -> 'still/yet'
L25n637.description: Fires on the first syllable of a word or name that splits into pieces (e.g. 'Pan' in Panzer, 'Bre' in Breasted, 'nan' in nanoscale, 'Hy' in Hyde, 'Or' in Ormara). Pushed positive, it promotes 'still/yet/còn' and repeats 'yet'.

L26n2604.name: Word root -> 'business'
L26n2604.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split word, e.g. 'car' in carbon and carotene, 'ver' in verbal and verbs, 'om' in Potomac. Pushed positive, it promotes 'business/businesses' and spams 'business'.

L26n1256.name: Spanish fragments -> 'os'
L26n1256.description: Fires on a mid-word or start piece of Spanish-flavoured or foreign words and names (e.g. 'Can' in Cañena, 'ma' in maquiladores, 'bur' in burrito, 'Chi' in Chiapas). Pushed negative, it promotes Spanish plural endings 'os', 'as', 'los', 'las' and spams 'os'.

L26n1241.name: 'cre/bre' onsets -> 'challenge'
L26n1241.description: Fires on word-opening 'cre', 'bre', 'stra', 'Mer' or 'gre' pieces of split words and names (Cremonesi, creepy, streusel, Merlin, Straub). Pushed positive, it promotes 'challenge/challenges' and spams 'challenge'.

L26n491.name: Name fragments -> quote-comma
L26n491.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split proper or technical name (e.g. 'then' in Parthenon, 'ru' in Pantagruelion, 'ipp' in Shippuden, 'Inter' in Interferometer). Pushed negative, it promotes closing-quote-comma tokens like '",' and '],'.

L26n942.name: Name starts -> 'external'
L26n942.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised place or proper name (e.g. 'Có' in Córdoba, 'Sp' in Sparta, 'Pr' in Prato, 'Al' in Alamein, 'Ob' in Ospo). Pushed positive, it promotes 'external/outer' and spams 'outermost'.

L25n706.name: Question/idea -> ';'
L25n706.description: Fires on nouns that set up a question or idea ('question' in 'the question - what...', 'idea' in 'One idea I like', 'use' after 'can'). Pushed negative, it promotes semicolons and spams them.

L26n2298.name: Word onsets -> 'stock'
L26n2298.description: Fires on the opening letter(s) of a word, mostly 'T/t', 'Pl', 'Ret' and 'Te' (e.g. 'T' in TWEAK, 'tummy', 'Pl' in plasma, 'Ret' in retriever). Pushed positive, it promotes 'stock/stocks' and spams 'stock'.

L25n709.name: Operation list connectors
L25n709.description: Fires on the comma or 'then'/'and' right before an arithmetic verb in a list of math or program tasks ('add, subtract, divide'), and on 'scalar' and 'common' in math text; pushes output toward 'multi' (multiply), so steered text stutters 'multi-multi'.

L26n1822.name: Mid-word fragments
L26n1822.description: Fires on a word piece that starts or sits inside a longer word or name split across tokens ('cur' in curricular, 'bor' in seborrhea, 'aling' in Stalingrad, 'ابن' in Ibn) before the word finishes; pushes toward 'ratio', so steered text repeats 'ratios'.

L26n1182.name: Al names and 'of'
L26n1182.description: Fires on 'Al' opening a name (Alfonso, Alonzo, Al Andalus) and on 'of' or 'Dead'/'Dynasty' right before a complement; pushes toward copula 'was/were/being', so steered text repeats 'was was was'.

L26n2543.name: Initial R of names
L26n2543.description: Fires on a capital 'R' or the 'rem'/'res'/'rhe' start of a word or name split into pieces (George R.R. Martin, Rama, Ravana, 'rem' in removes); pushes toward 'sky' and 'heaven', so steered text repeats 'sky sky'.

L25n2193.name: Rare-word middle pieces
L25n2193.description: Fires on the middle piece of a rare, multi-token technical or proper word (Uffizi 'ff', dihydrotestosterone 'hydro', cinnamomum 'inn', aminoglycoside 'ly', arrhythmia 'yth'); pushes toward '!', so steered text becomes '!!!!!'.

L25n1646.name: Enc fragments and negation
L25n1646.description: Fires on 'enc' starting enclosed, encroached or encourage, and on 'not' or 'n't' after a modal or verb ('should not compete', 'do not splash'); pushes toward 'cross', so steered text drifts to 'crossing'.

L26n686.name: Verb stems before -ing
L26n686.description: Fires on the first piece of a verb stem split before its '-ing' ending (squ|ishing, susp|ending, sm|acking, exh|aling, att|aining); pushes toward '-ing' participle adjectives such as 'inspiring' and 'engaging', so steered text repeats 'inspiring'.

L26n87.name: Answer-opening 'Here's'
L26n87.description: Fires on the lead-in words that open an answer before its content ('Here's', 'Here is', 'To put it simply', 'put it another way'); pushes toward off-topic nouns like _security and _payment, and steered output shows little clear effect.

L25n1231.name: Requirement-verb slot, software
L25n1231.description: Fires on the word just before the main verb in software requirement text ('should [be] designed', 'that [is] capable', 'more [convenient]') and on framework or game names (React, Vue, Canvas, Minecraft); pushes toward 'performance' and 'optimize'.

L26n670.name: Recipe quantity slot
L26n670.description: Fires on the space token right after a list dash, just before the quantity in recipe ingredient lists ('- 2 tablespoons', '- 1 pound'), and on 'years' or 'inches' before a number; pushes toward size words 'large' and 'small'.

L26n2598.name: Place-name initial pieces
L26n2598.description: Fires on the first 1-3 letters of a proper or place name split into pieces (Bar in Barrow-upon-Humber and Barataria, Kos|ra|e, Mag in Magritte, Ele in Elephants); pushes toward 'contact', so steered text repeats 'contact'.

L25n2860.name: List connectors, project
L25n2860.description: Fires on the comma, 'and' or 'or' that joins parallel items in a list of business, management or method names ('marketing, finance', 'Asana or Trello', 'Booch, OMT and OOSE'); pushes toward 'project', so steered text repeats 'project'.

L26n1008.name: Latinized word fragments
L26n1008.description: Fires on the middle piece of rare, foreign or Latinized words split into odd pieces ('yl' in xylitol, 'ṭ' in Sanskrit saṃghaṭṭa, 'gl' in glomerata, 'iv' in olivaceus); pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ção' and 'ried', with little visible effect when steered.

L25n664.name: Enumeration labels, name starts
L25n664.description: Fires on a parenthesized sub-part label opening a list item ('(b) Is it closed', '(c) A polygon') or on the first piece of a name ('Mazaheri', 'Croesus', 'Al' in Alfonso); pushes toward code '=' tokens like '=DB' and '=document'.

L26n768.name: Split name starts
L26n768.description: Fires on the first piece of a split proper name (Buk|ima, Gh|afiqi, Kh|ulaifi, Sidd|ons, 'udd' in Shamsuddin) and on commas listing form fields; pushes toward 'token' and '_TOKEN' tokens.

L26n2584.name: Proper-name pieces
L26n2584.description: Fires on a piece of a proper name split across tokens (Que|ensland, Pr|zew|alski, Tex|ian, Serg|ipe, Lem|ur), especially 'zew' in Przewalski; pushes toward accented 'é' and 'è' tokens, so steered text becomes 'é é é'.

L26n261.name: Compound mid-word pieces
L26n261.description: Fires on the middle piece of a word or URL split across tokens (bra|ai, cha|me|leons, dys|lexia, Fem|ales, the '-r' in cyber-safety-rules); pushes toward short word-continuation pieces ('em', 'se', 'sh', 'ph'), so steered text breaks into odd partial words.

L25n1118.name: Leftover after quantity
L25n1118.description: Fires on the noun or quantity word after 'few', 'had', 'have' or 'a' that states what remains ('a few days left', '8 mice left', 'had nothing in common', 'wasn't much'); pushes toward 'left', so steered text repeats 'left left'.

L26n2966.name: Bridge-like word pieces
L26n2966.description: Fires on the 'brid' or 'rid' piece that starts words ending in -ge or -ged (Bridgeton, Bridgestone, ridges, bridged, wedges, sponges, sieges); pushes toward the word-ending pieces 'get', 'ged', 'ges', 'ging', so steered text stutters 'getget'.

L25n604.name: Word end before quote
L25n604.description: Fires on the last piece of a word or phrase just before a closing quotation mark (‘majestic’, ‘hematoma’, ‘composed’, ‘superstitions’, ‘perfection’); pushes toward closing quote marks ’ and ”.

L26n210.name: Word-stem fragment before suffix
L26n210.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split across tokens, just before its ending (e.g. 'd' in doped, 'mol' in molten, 'vis' in viscoelastic); pushes suffix pieces like 'ary', 'ably', 'ate'.

L25n2145.name: Field label before 'number'
L25n2145.description: Fires on the label word of a form or catalog field where a value is expected next (e.g. 'phone' in 'phone number', 'Control' in 'LC Control Number', 'ID', 'port', 'version'); pushes 'number'.

L26n1188.name: Verb stem before participle
L26n1188.description: Fires on the first piece of a verb cut mid-word in passive or perfect slots (e.g. 'l' in 'lured', 'em' in 'emigrated', 'f' in 'fiddled'); pushes past-participle verbs like 'processed', 'recorded', 'harvested'.

L26n845.name: Medical mechanism connectives
L26n845.description: Strongly negative on function words and nouns mid-sentence in medical and hormone mechanism text (e.g. 'growth' in 'growth hormone', 'with' in 'activated with', 'when' in 'happens when'); pushes body-part nouns like 'bone', 'skin', 'scalp'.

L26n2786.name: Stem fragment, writes 'gen'
L26n2786.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a word split across tokens, mostly science stems (e.g. 'chlor' in chlorides, 'cultiv' in cultivars, 'rust' in rustica); pushes 'generation' and a bare 'g' token.

L26n124.name: Compound-term modifier
L26n124.description: Fires on the modifier half of a technical compound or name (e.g. 'electronic' in electronic cigarettes, '-step' in forest-steppe, 'micro' in microasperities, 'bit' in bit.ly); pushes 'another' and 'further'.

L26n2866.name: Transport and traffic nouns
L26n2866.description: Strongly negative on transport nouns in road, rail and subway text (e.g. 'ticket' in ticket hall, 'subway', 'traffic', 'highway', 'lanes'); pushes toward 'travel'.

L25n1454.name: Infinitive 'to' in promotion
L25n1454.description: Fires on 'to' opening an infinitive of purpose (e.g. 'ways to', 'how to', 'to endorse'), mostly in advertising and marketing text; pushes 'promote' and 'promoting'.

L25n932.name: URL domain letters
L25n932.description: Fires on the short letters right after 'www.' or a dot in a URL or domain (e.g. 'm' in www.mindbites, 'd' in www.dhs.gov, 's' in www.safetyserve); pushes short abbreviation tokens like 'bc', 'dna', 'cbc'.

L26n3007.name: 'years' in age phrases
L26n3007.description: Strongly negative on 'year(s)' right after a number in an age phrase (e.g. 'seven years old', '65 years and older', '3 years old'); pushes 'old'.

L26n194.name: Digits inside years
L26n194.description: Strongly negative on a middle digit of a multi-digit number, mostly years (e.g. the '9' in 1979, the '5' in 250 million, the '8' in 1863); pushes weak foreign-word fragments.

L25n2216.name: Computer and hardware nouns
L25n2216.description: Strongly negative on computing and hardware nouns (e.g. 'computer' in targeted computer, 'server', 'device', 'GPU', 'Arduino', 'system' in system components); pushes 'power' and 'software'.

L26n641.name: 'National' in org names
L26n641.description: Fires on the first word of an organization name, mostly 'National' (National Science Foundation) or 'American', in education and science text; pushes 'math' and 'mathematics'.

L26n1116.name: Number words and numerals
L26n1116.description: Strongly negative on a number word or numeral naming a quantity, time, or date (e.g. 'eight' in 'at eight o'clock', 'Eight' in Eighty Years' War, 'April' in 'April 1'); pushes digit tokens 0-9.

L25n827.name: Slot before 'get' verb
L25n827.description: Strongly negative on the word just before a verb slot of getting or gaining (e.g. 'to' in 'where to get help', 'you' in 'sleep you obtain', 're' in 'they're getting'); pushes 'get', 'gain', 'obtain'.

L26n1363.name: Name fragments, JS output
L26n1363.description: Strongly negative on a mid-word piece of a proper name or species (e.g. 'rg' in Jorgensen, 'Han' in Hanuman, 'chin' in Litchi chinensis, 'pt' in Leptin); pushes 'undefined' and 'document' (JavaScript).

L26n19.name: Onset fragment, pushes punctuation
L26n19.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a word split across tokens, often 'cl' (clots, clotted), 'par', 'vacc', 'sc'; pushes punctuation and backslash tokens.

L25n2517.name: 'is' before 'home to'
L25n2517.description: Fires on the copula 'is' right after a place or body-part subject that opens a description (e.g. 'Africa is', 'Nigeria is', 'Our mouth is'), most where 'home to' follows; pushes 'home'.

L25n1521.name: 'vector' and its components
L25n1521.description: Strongly negative on 'vector' or 'eigenvectors' in linear-algebra and field-theory text, plus some name fragments like 'in' in Mackinac; pushes 'components'.

L26n799.name: Pr- and pencil fragments
L26n799.description: Strongly negative on word-start fragments 'pr' (pruned, prairie) and 'apr' (apricots), and on 'pencil' in art-supply text; pushes 'highlight', 'emphasize', 'underscore'.

L26n765.name: People-group nouns before possessive
L26n765.description: Plural people-group nouns (Women, Children, Patients, Doctors, students, girls) and people-referring pronouns (their, who) peak as they appear; pushes the model toward writing an apostrophe-s or 'd possessive or contraction right after them.

L25n1253.name: Institutional mechanism nouns
L25n1253.description: Negative on process or mechanism nouns in policy and institutional text (reward, Vote, quota, review, alert, reserve, fee, feedback), peaking on the word that names the mechanism; pushing negative drives the model to write 'system'.

L26n41.name: Word-start fragment before completion
L26n41.description: The incomplete first or middle piece of a word split into tokens (ab in abundance, -st in non-stick, Under in Understand) and Japanese を or が particles; pushes toward odd word-start fragments and filler such as 'waiting'.

L25n2684.name: n/kn word pieces
L25n2684.description: Short n, ne, kne or ut pieces that open the second part of a word split across tokens (kne in kneading, n in nodule, ne in neutrons, -ne in k-nearest), plus Kubernetes; the steering effect is weak and writes little that is clear.
L25n2684.name_orig: Word pieces starting with n or kn

L25n185.name: List commas, caps connectors
L25n185.description: Commas inside lists and ALL-CAPS headings, plus IS, OF, THE, TO in caps titles, the Arabic ibn in names, and | separators; pushes only weakly toward position or fit words, so the concept is unclear.

L26n1149.name: Mid-word fragment, predicts ug
L26n1149.description: Mid-word pieces of split words (inde- in indestructible, ana- in anaerobic, -ile in silex, ole in oleifera, Nicola); pushes toward 'ug', 'ud' and 'ux' word-end fragments.

L26n407.name: Spec/list punctuation, address words
L26n407.description: Full stops that end spec-like or list items, colons before values, dashes before field labels, and address words (Avenue, Fifth, Telephone); pushes toward table or code row and page property names such as RowIndex, PageSize and Head.
L26n407.name_orig: Spec and list punctuation, address words

L25n1680.name: Romanized name fragment, u
L25n1680.description: Middle pieces of transliterated Arabic and Persian names split across tokens (Ghaf in Al Ghafiqi, Ikhtiyar, Shams-ud-din, Zul-kifli, Abdu'l); pushes the model into 'u' and 'ul' spam.

L25n1543.name: Mid-word fragment, predicts -ent
L25n1543.description: Incomplete word pieces that wait for an -ent, -ens or -ion ending (appreh-ended, preh-ension, oll-inated, Jø-rgensen), plus hou and Sole fragments; pushes toward -ent, -ension and -inant endings.

L25n1712.name: Name-internal connectives, record/log
L25n1712.description: Connectors and word-internal pieces inside multi-token names or lists (and in EPA and DHA, Con in Immaculate Conception, been after had, the ith in hadith); pushes toward 'record' and 'log', which reads as weak.
L25n1712.name_orig: Connectives inside names, record or log

L26n2737.name: Determiner opening noun phrase
L26n2737.description: Determiners and possessives (their, its, the, Its) that open a noun phrase, and word starts such as di and menstr; pushes the model to write 'period' or 'periods'.

L25n2791.name: Cost/fee nouns, predicts cover
L25n2791.description: Cost, fee and proceeds nouns (cost-effective, cost of goods, fees, revenues) and 'to' after ability or time phrases in finance text; pushes the model toward writing 'cover', as in cover costs.
L25n2791.name_orig: Cost and fee nouns, predicts cover

L26n856.name: List-item head noun, steps/terms
L26n856.description: The first word of a list item or category name (macaws in parrots, macaws; focus in focus groups; sub in subheadings; food in food chains); pushes toward sequence nouns such as steps, terms and stages.
L26n856.name_orig: List-item head noun, steps or terms

L26n2426.name: Name-internal fragment, predicts ier
L26n2426.description: Mid-word fragments of European surnames and terms split across tokens (Mart-el, Mer-cier, Gau-guin, Ikht-iyar, Agr-arian); pushes toward French-style ier and ière endings.

L26n2927.name: Prefix or word-first piece
L26n2927.description: The first piece of a word split across tokens, especially compound prefixes and capitalized starts (hetero-porous, self-d-etermination, non-d-iscriminatory, Cons-istent, S-ponsored); pushes toward word-end fragments such as -ete, -ys and -ez.
L26n2927.name_orig: Prefix or first piece of a word

L25n3012.name: Organization-name word, predicts control
L25n3012.description: Capitalized words inside organization and institution names (Central Statistical, Christian Science, Management Board, meteorological, Daily) and Cons starts; pushes the model toward 'control' spam.

L26n764.name: Organization-name start, predicts leaves
L26n764.description: Capitalized first pieces of organization and agency names (UN, Air in Air Force, Sp in Sparta, Space, treaty); pushes toward 'leaves' and 'sets' verbs, which reads as unrelated.

L25n1980.name: Predicate slot before central
L25n1980.description: The article or verb just before the predicate of a definitional topic sentence (is an, was, plays a, is of key importance); pushes toward 'central', 'center' and 'core'.

L25n1486.name: Statistics and quantity words
L25n1486.description: Digits, numbers and quantity words in statistics and news (the 1 in a 2001 census, exact number, sales, projected, considerable amount); pushes the model toward 'figure' and 'figures' spam.

L26n1963.name: Word-internal fragment, predicts ing
L26n1963.description: Word-internal pieces that wait for a suffix (cytok-ines, spr-outs, Veter-inarians, cont-ortionists, Shamsuddin); pushes toward 'ing' and 'ings' spam.

L26n2333.name: Split-word opening fragments
L26n2333.description: Fires on the first short piece of a word split into subword tokens, mostly 'f', 'Fe', 'inf', 'conf' (feline, infested, confute, Feinberg). Pushes the model toward 'function(s)', which steering shows only weakly.

L25n680.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L25n680.description: Fires on a leading or middle subword piece of a split word, e.g. 'und' in Undoubtedly, 'pend' in pendent, 'inter' in interconnect, 'bed' in Ambedkar, 'pre' in pre-image, and some whole words in technical text. Pushes toward 'unit'/'Unit'.

L26n211.name: Tech names, code requests
L26n211.description: Fires on programming and tool names (PHP, MySQL, Vue, Arduino, '.js', canvas) and on the connector right after them ('and' in 'PHP and MySQL', 'that' in 'a PHP script that'). Pushes toward rare word-pieces ('icum', 'nar') with no clear sense.

L25n2816.name: Data-analysis prose context
L25n2816.description: Fires on function words and word-pieces in data-science and statistics prose, e.g. 'for' in 'label encoding for this task', 'of' in 'analysis of complex datasets', 'between' in 'regression and classification'. Pushes toward 'factor'/'categories', and steering repeats 'factor'.

L26n2020.name: K-initial name fragments
L26n2020.description: Fires on a 'K' or 'k' opening piece of a split word or name (Kassites, KwaZulu, kerosene, Kafka, Kunitz, kinases, Qanat). Pushes toward 'space', and steered text turns into 'space-faring' spam.

L26n749.name: Capitalized proper-noun openers
L26n749.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalized name or title (St in St. Louis, Sch in Schleper, Matt in Matthew, S in Sutra, O in OHSU). Pushes toward end-of-sentence punctuation ('.', ':', ';'), and steering repeats '.'.

L25n2727.name: Heart and stroke risk
L25n2727.description: Fires on the word right after a cardiovascular or disease-risk phrase, e.g. 'called' after 'arterial hypertension', 'of' in 'risk of stroke', 'and' in 'heart disease and stroke', 'developing' in 'risk of developing'. Pushes toward 'heart', and steering repeats it.

L25n1274.name: Closing think-tag token
L25n1274.description: Fires on the '</think>' token that closes the empty reasoning block right before the answer in chat-format responses, almost every time. Pushes toward closing quote-paren code pairs, with little visible effect.

L25n496.name: Word-prefix fragments
L25n496.description: Fires on a word-opening prefix piece that a longer word continues from, e.g. 'tele' in telepathically, 'hyper' in hyperbole, 'self' in self-love, 'non' in nonstick, 'vin' in kelvin. Pushes toward a bare 'k', and steering outputs 'kkkk' spam.

L26n2016.name: Function words before verbs
L26n2016.description: Fires on a function word that sets up a verb, mostly 'to', 'be', 'by', 'can', 'which' in procedural tech text ('used to determine', 'will be joining', 'found by quadrature'), plus 'hash' and 'DNA'. Pushes toward 'compare'/'cross', and steering repeats 'cross'.

L25n40.name: Link and citation closers
L25n40.description: Fires on the last word of a link anchor, credential or citation tail, e.g. 'here' in 'click here', 'link', 'page', 'below', 'YouTube', 'Reader', 'Ph.D', 'Inc'. Pushes toward closing quotes and brackets, and steering emits only spaces and newlines.

L25n2079.name: Bracket and enclosure wording
L25n2079.description: Fires on 'square' in 'square brackets' and on prepositions that introduce a container, e.g. 'enclosed in', 'in' before 'the Suggestions area' or 'the sidebar'. Pushes toward 'square'/'Br' (brackets), and steering repeats 'square'.

L25n2138.name: Rate-of-change verbs
L25n2138.description: Fires on a verb or adjective for a change in speed, level or state, e.g. 'advancing' technology, 'rising' population, 'melt(ing)' and 'warm' faster, 'accelerate', 'moves' backwards, 'too' large. Pushes toward 'fast'/'Fast', and steering repeats 'fast'.

L26n83.name: Word-piece openers, 'but' writer
L26n83.description: Fires on a word-opening piece such as 'pamph' (pamphlets), 'mol' (molten), 'pur' (purists), 'pr' (prisms), and on the bracket, hyphen or comma inside a figure (the '(' before a metric conversion, the '-' in STS-51-G). Pushes toward contrast words 'but', 'then', 'than', and steered text repeats 'then'.

L25n1771.name: Proper-name mid fragments
L25n1771.description: Fires on the middle or end subword piece of a proper name split into tokens (Rom in Rommel, Sand in Sandia, lem in Charlemagne, orm in Hormoran, alm in Falmouth). Pushes toward 'self'/'-self', and steering yields 'self-actualized' and 'self-teller'.

L25n712.name: 'bas' word fragment
L25n712.description: Fires on word-opening fragments of longer words, strongest on 'bas' (basins, basal, basmati, Bas-Armagnac), and also 'wast', 'wid', 'hash', 'orang'. Pushes toward 'ax'/'ex' tokens with little visible effect.

L26n2209.name: Foreign name fragments
L26n2209.description: Fires on a non-English or unusual piece inside a name or foreign word (ø in Jørgensen, Caj in Cajete, Ber in Berber, Est in Estepa, Chi in Chiapas, idade in Universidade). Pushes toward 'est'/'Est' tokens, and steered story text starts with 'Estra'.

L25n63.name: Pre-noun modifiers
L25n63.description: Fires on an adjective or determiner right before the noun it modifies, e.g. 'black' in black plastic or black tea, 'magical' in magical powers, 'important' in most important advancement, 'practical' in practical preimage attack, 'a' before 'line'. Pushes toward time-order words ('afterwards', 'before', 'later'), and steered text fills with 'once' and 'before'.

L26n1770.name: Biomedical terms, DNA
L26n1770.description: Fires on biology and medicine terms and their word pieces, e.g. 'acid' in fatty acid synthase, 'endocrine', 'cutaneous', 'dopamine', 'Alzheimer', 'cervical', plus 'Ne' in Neolithic and neutrophils. Pushes toward 'gene'/'genetic' and 'DNA'/'RNA', and steering repeats 'DNA'.

L26n1019.name: Dosing and treatment terms
L26n1019.description: Fires on dosing and treatment words in medical text, e.g. 'ose' in one- or two-dose, 'dosage', 'dosing' interval, 'antibiotic' treatments, 'prescribing', 'ketogenic' diets. Pushes toward 'reg' (regimen), and steering produces 'regressed' and 'regal' fragments.
